Response Text:---
The `placePipe` method should convert the given row and column into a `Coordinate` (likely 1-based to 0-based adjustment), then try to place the current pipe from the `pipeQueue` onto the map at that coordinate. If successful, it should update the `pipeQueue` (remove the placed pipe), update the `delayBar` (likely reset or update delay), push the placed cell onto `cellStack` for undo purposes, and increment the `numOfSteps`.

Here is a complete implementation of the `placePipe` method:

```java
public boolean placePipe(int row, char col) {
    // Convert 1-based row and char column to Coordinate (assuming col 'A' -> 1)
    int colIndex = Character.toUpperCase(col) - 'A' + 1;
    Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(row, colIndex);

    // Get the current pipe from the queue
    Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.peek();
    if (currentPipe == null) {
        return false; // no pipe to place
    }

    // Try to place the pipe on the map
    boolean placed = map.placePipe(coord, currentPipe);
    if (!placed) {
        return false;
    }

    // Successfully placed the pipe:
    // Remove the pipe from the queue
    pipeQueue.poll();

    // Update delay bar (assuming delayBar.tick() or similar method to update)
    delayBar.reset();

    // Push the placed cell onto the cell stack for undo
    Cell placedCell = map.getCell(coord);
    if (placedCell instanceof FillableCell) {
        cellStack.push(coord, (FillableCell) placedCell);
    }

    // Increment the number of steps
    numOfSteps++;

    return true;
}
```

**Notes:**
- `pipeQueue.peek()` gets the current pipe without removing it.
- `pipeQueue.poll()` removes the current pipe after successful placement.
- `map.placePipe(Coordinate, Pipe)` tries to place the pipe and returns whether it succeeded.
- `delayBar.reset()` is assumed to reset the delay bar after placing a pipe.
- `cellStack.push(Coordinate, FillableCell)` stores the placed cell for undo.
- `numOfSteps` increments after a successful placement.

Adjust method calls if your actual API differs slightly.

public boolean undoStep() {
    if (cellStack.isEmpty()) {
        return false;
    }
    var last = cellStack.pop();
    Coordinate coord = last.coordinate();

    map.resetCell(coord); // Assuming Map has a method to reset a cell to empty or original state
    numOfSteps++;
    return true;
}

	public void Game(int rows, int cols, int delay, Cell[][] cells, List<Pipe> pipes) {
		this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2, cells);
		this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue(pipes);
		this.delayBar = new DelayBar(delay);
		this.numOfSteps = 0;
		this.cellStack.clear();

	public boolean placePipe(int row, char col) {
		int colIndex = Character.toUpperCase(col) - 'A' + 1;
		Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(row, colIndex);
		Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.peek();
		if (currentPipe == null) {
			return false;
		}
		boolean placed = map.placePipe(coord, currentPipe);
		if (!placed) {
			return false;
		}
		pipeQueue.poll();
		delayBar.reset();
		Cell placedCell = map.getCell(coord);
		if (placedCell instanceof FillableCell) {
			cellStack.push(coord, (FillableCell) placedCell);
		}
		numOfSteps++;
		return true;
	}

	/**
	 * Directly skips the current pipe and use the next pipe.
	 */
	public void skipPipe() {
		if (pipeQueue.peek() != null) {
			pipeQueue.poll();
			delayBar.reset();
			numOfSteps++;
		}
	}

	public boolean undoStep() {
		if (cellStack.isEmpty()) {
			return false;
		}
		var last = cellStack.pop();
		Coordinate coord = last.coordinate();
		FillableCell cell = last.cell();
		map.resetCell(coord);
		numOfSteps++;
		return true;
	}
}

public class Game {

	@NotNull
	private final Map map;
	@NotNull
	private final PipeQueue pipeQueue;
	@NotNull
	private final DelayBar delayBar;
	@NotNull
	private final CellStack cellStack = new CellStack();

	private int numOfSteps = 0;

	/**
	 * Creates a game with a given map and various properties.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * This constructor is a convenience method for unit testing purposes.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @param rows Number of rows of the given map.
	 * @param cols Number of columns of the given map.
	 * @param delay Delay in number of rounds before filling the pipes.
	 * @param cellsRep String representation of the map, with columns delimited by {@code '\n'}.
	 * @param pipes List of pre-generated pipes, if any.
	 * @return A game constructed with the given parameters.
	 */
	@NotNull
	static Game fromString(int rows, int cols, int delay, @NotNull String cellsRep, @Nullable List<Pipe> pipes) {
		var cells = Deserializer.parseString(rows, cols, cellsRep);

		return new Game(rows, cols, delay, cells, pipes);
	}

	/**
	 * Displays the current game state.
	 */
	public void display() {
		map.display();
		System.out.println();
		pipeQueue.display();
		cellStack.display();
		System.out.println();
		delayBar.display();
	}

	/**
	 * @return Number of steps the player has taken.
	 */
	public int getNumOfSteps() {
		// TODO
		return 0;
	}

	public void Game(int rows, int cols) {
		this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2);
		this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue();
		this.delayBar = new DelayBar();
		this.numOfSteps = 0;
	}

	public void Game(int rows, int cols, int delay, Cell[][] cells, List<Pipe> pipes) {
		this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2, cells);
		this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue(pipes);
		this.delayBar = new DelayBar(delay);
		this.numOfSteps = 0;
		this.cellStack.clear();
	}

	public boolean placePipe(int row, char col) {
		int colIndex = Character.toUpperCase(col) - 'A' + 1;
		Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(row, colIndex);
		Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.peek();
		if (currentPipe == null) {
			return false;
		}
		boolean placed = map.placePipe(coord, currentPipe);
		if (!placed) {
			return false;
		}
		pipeQueue.poll();
		delayBar.reset();
		Cell placedCell = map.getCell(coord);
		if (placedCell instanceof FillableCell) {
			cellStack.push(coord, (FillableCell) placedCell);
		}
		numOfSteps++;
		return true;
	}

	/**
	 * Directly skips the current pipe and use the next pipe.
	 */
	public void skipPipe() {
		if (pipeQueue.peek() != null) {
			pipeQueue.poll();
			delayBar.reset();
			numOfSteps++;
		}
	}

	public boolean undoStep() {
		if (cellStack.isEmpty()) {
			return false;
		}
		var last = cellStack.pop();
		Coordinate coord = last.coordinate();
		FillableCell cell = last.cell();
		map.resetCell(coord);
		numOfSteps++;
		return true;
	}

	public void updateState() {
		delayBar.tick();
		int distance = delayBar.getValue();
		map.fillTiles(distance);
	}

	/**
	 * Checks whether the game is won.
	 * @return   {@code  true}  if the game is won.
	 */
	public boolean hasWon() {
		return map.hasWon();
	}

	/**
	 * Checks whether the game is lost. <p> Hint: This method should invoke  {@link Map#hasLost()} . You may also need other judgements. </p>
	 * @return   {@code  true}  if the game is lost.
	 */
	public boolean hasLost() {
		return map.hasLost() || (pipeQueue.isEmpty() && !hasWon());
	}
}

		this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue();
		this.delayBar = new DelayBar();
		this.numOfSteps = 0;
	}

	public void Game(int rows, int cols, int delay, Cell[][] cells, List<Pipe> pipes) {
		this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2, cells);
		this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue(pipes);
		this.delayBar = new DelayBar(delay);
		this.numOfSteps = 0;
		this.cellStack.clear();
	}

	public boolean placePipe(int row, char col) {
		int colIndex = Character.toUpperCase(col) - 'A' + 1;
		Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(row, colIndex);
		Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.peek();
		if (currentPipe == null) {
			return false;
		}
		boolean placed = map.placePipe(coord, currentPipe);
		if (!placed) {
			return false;
		}
		pipeQueue.poll();
		delayBar.reset();
		Cell placedCell = map.getCell(coord);
		if (placedCell instanceof FillableCell) {
			cellStack.push(coord, (FillableCell) placedCell);
		}
		numOfSteps++;
		return true;
	}

	/**
	 * Directly skips the current pipe and use the next pipe.
	 */
	public void skipPipe() {
		if (pipeQueue.peek() != null) {
			pipeQueue.poll();
			delayBar.reset();
			numOfSteps++;
		}
	}

	public boolean undoStep() {
		if (cellStack.isEmpty()) {
			return false;
		}
		var last = cellStack.pop();
		Coordinate coord = last.coordinate();
		FillableCell cell = last.cell();
		map.resetCell(coord);
		numOfSteps++;
		return true;
	}

	public void updateState() {
		delayBar.tick();
		int distance = delayBar.getValue();
		map.fillTiles(distance);
	}

	/**
	 * Checks whether the game is won.
	 * @return   {@code  true}  if the game is won.
	 */
	public boolean hasWon() {
		return map.hasWon();
	}

	/**
	 * Checks whether the game is lost. <p> Hint: This method should invoke  {@link Map#hasLost()} . You may also need other judgements. </p>
	 * @return   {@code  true}  if the game is lost.
	 */
	public boolean hasLost() {
		return map.hasLost() || (pipeQueue.isEmpty() && !hasWon());
	}

In Java, constructors must not have a return type, not even `void`.

You need to replace these two methods:

```java
public void Game(int rows, int cols) { ... }

import game.map.Map;

    @NotNull

     * @param pipes List of pre-generated pipes, if any.
     * @return A game constructed with the given parameters.
     */
    @NotNull
    static Game fromString(int rows, int cols, int delay, @NotNull String cellsRep, @Nullable List<Pipe> pipes) {
        var cells = Deserializer.parseString(rows, cols, cellsRep);

        return new Game(rows, cols, delay, cells, pipes);
    }

        delayBar.display();
    }

        this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue(pipes);
        this.delayBar = new DelayBar(delay);
        this.numOfSteps = 0;
        this.cellStack.clear();

    public boolean placePipe(int row, char col) {

        Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.peek();

            delayBar.reset();
            numOfSteps++;
        }
    }

        Coordinate coord = last.coordinate();

package game;

import game.map.Map;
import game.map.cells.Cell;
import game.map.cells.FillableCell;
import game.pipes.Pipe;
import io.Deserializer;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import util.Coordinate;

import java.util.List;

public class Game {

	@NotNull
	private final Map map;
	@NotNull
	private final PipeQueue pipeQueue;
	@NotNull
	private final DelayBar delayBar;
	@NotNull
	private final CellStack cellStack = new CellStack();

	private int numOfSteps = 0;

	/**
	 * Creates a game with a given map and various properties.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * This constructor is a convenience method for unit testing purposes.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @param rows Number of rows of the given map.
	 * @param cols Number of columns of the given map.
	 * @param delay Delay in number of rounds before filling the pipes.
	 * @param cellsRep String representation of the map, with columns delimited by {@code '\n'}.
	 * @param pipes List of pre-generated pipes, if any.
	 * @return A game constructed with the given parameters.
	 */
	@NotNull
	static Game fromString(int rows, int cols, int delay, @NotNull String cellsRep, @Nullable List<Pipe> pipes) {
		var cells = Deserializer.parseString(rows, cols, cellsRep);

		return new Game(rows, cols, delay, cells, pipes);
	}

	/**
	 * Displays the current game state.
	 */
	public void display() {
		map.display();
		System.out.println();
		pipeQueue.display();
		cellStack.display();
		System.out.println();
		delayBar.display();
	}

	/**
	 * @return Number of steps the player has taken.
	 */
	public int getNumOfSteps() {
		// TODO
		return 0;
	}

	public void Game(int rows, int cols) {
		this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2);
		this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue();
		this.delayBar = new DelayBar();
		this.numOfSteps = 0;
	}

	public void Game(int rows, int cols, int delay, Cell[][] cells, List<Pipe> pipes) {
		this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2, cells);
		this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue(pipes);
		this.delayBar = new DelayBar(delay);
		this.numOfSteps = 0;
		this.cellStack.clear();
	}

	public boolean placePipe(int row, char col) {
		int colIndex = Character.toUpperCase(col) - 'A' + 1;
		Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(row, colIndex);
		Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.peek();
		if (currentPipe == null) {
			return false;
		}
		boolean placed = map.placePipe(coord, currentPipe);
		if (!placed) {
			return false;
		}
		pipeQueue.poll();
		delayBar.reset();
		Cell placedCell = map.getCell(coord);
		if (placedCell instanceof FillableCell) {
			cellStack.push(coord, (FillableCell) placedCell);
		}
		numOfSteps++;
		return true;
	}

	/**
	 * Directly skips the current pipe and use the next pipe.
	 */
	public void skipPipe() {
		if (pipeQueue.peek() != null) {
			pipeQueue.poll();
			delayBar.reset();
			numOfSteps++;
		}
	}

	public boolean undoStep() {
		if (cellStack.isEmpty()) {
			return false;
		}
		var last = cellStack.pop();
		Coordinate coord = last.coordinate();
		FillableCell cell = last.cell();
		map.resetCell(coord);
		numOfSteps++;
		return true;
	}

	public void updateState() {
		delayBar.tick();
		int distance = delayBar.getValue();
		map.fillTiles(distance);
	}

	/**
	 * Checks whether the game is won.
	 * @return   {@code  true}  if the game is won.
	 */
	public boolean hasWon() {
		return map.hasWon();
	}

	/**
	 * Checks whether the game is lost. <p> Hint: This method should invoke  {@link Map#hasLost()} . You may also need other judgements. </p>
	 * @return   {@code  true}  if the game is lost.
	 */
	public boolean hasLost() {
		return map.hasLost() || (pipeQueue.isEmpty() && !hasWon());
	}
}

Response Text:---
The errors occur because the methods named `Game` are not constructors but regular void methods. Constructors in Java must not have a return type, not even `void`. You need to change these methods to proper constructors by removing the `void` keyword.

Here is the corrected `Game` class with proper constructors:

```java
package game;

import game.map.Map;
import game.map.cells.Cell;
import game.map.cells.FillableCell;
import game.pipes.Pipe;
import io.Deserializer;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import util.Coordinate;

import java.util.List;

public class Game {

    @NotNull
    private final Map map;
    @NotNull
    private final PipeQueue pipeQueue;
    @NotNull
    private final DelayBar delayBar;
    @NotNull
    private final CellStack cellStack = new CellStack();

    private int numOfSteps = 0;

    /**
     * Creates a game with a given map and various properties.
     *
     * <p>
     * This constructor is a convenience method for unit testing purposes.
     * </p>
     *
     * @param rows Number of rows of the given map.
     * @param cols Number of columns of the given map.
     * @param delay Delay in number of rounds before filling the pipes.
     * @param cellsRep String representation of the map, with columns delimited by {@code '\n'}.
     * @param pipes List of pre-generated pipes, if any.
     * @return A game constructed with the given parameters.
     */
    @NotNull
    static Game fromString(int rows, int cols, int delay, @NotNull String cellsRep, @Nullable List<Pipe> pipes) {
        var cells = Deserializer.parseString(rows, cols, cellsRep);

        return new Game(rows, cols, delay, cells, pipes);
    }

    /**
     * Displays the current game state.
     */
    public void display() {
        map.display();
        System.out.println();
        pipeQueue.display();
        cellStack.display();
        System.out.println();
        delayBar.display();
    }

    /**
     * @return Number of steps the player has taken.
     */
    public int getNumOfSteps() {
        return numOfSteps;
    }

    // Correct constructor: no return type
    public Game(int rows, int cols) {
        this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2);
        this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue();
        this.delayBar = new DelayBar();
        this.numOfSteps = 0;
    }

    // Correct constructor: no return type
    public Game(int rows, int cols, int delay, Cell[][] cells, List<Pipe> pipes) {
        this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2, cells);
        this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue(pipes);
        this.delayBar = new DelayBar(delay);
        this.numOfSteps = 0;
        this.cellStack.clear();
    }

    public boolean placePipe(int row, char col) {
        int colIndex = Character.toUpperCase(col) - 'A' + 1;
        Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(row, colIndex);
        Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.peek();
        if (currentPipe == null) {
            return false;
        }
        boolean placed = map.placePipe(coord, currentPipe);
        if (!placed) {
            return false;
        }
        pipeQueue.poll();
        delayBar.reset();
        Cell placedCell = map.getCell(coord);
        if (placedCell instanceof FillableCell) {
            cellStack.push(coord, (FillableCell) placedCell);
        }
        numOfSteps++;
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Directly skips the current pipe and use the next pipe.
     */
    public void skipPipe() {
        if (pipeQueue.peek() != null) {
            pipeQueue.poll();
            delayBar.reset();
            numOfSteps++;
        }
    }

    public boolean undoStep() {
        if (cellStack.isEmpty()) {
            return false;
        }
        var last = cellStack.pop();
        Coordinate coord = last.coordinate();
        FillableCell cell = last.cell();
        map.resetCell(coord);
        numOfSteps++;
        return true;
    }

    public void updateState() {
        delayBar.tick();
        int distance = delayBar.getValue();
        map.fillTiles(distance);
    }

    /**
     * Checks whether the game is won.
     * @return   {@code  true}  if the game is won.
     */
    public boolean hasWon() {
        return map.hasWon();
    }

    /**
     * Checks whether the game is lost. <p> Hint: This method should invoke  {@link Map#hasLost()} . You may also need other judgements. </p>
     * @return   {@code  true}  if the game is lost.
     */
    public boolean hasLost() {
        return map.hasLost() || (pipeQueue.isEmpty() && !hasWon());
    }
}
```

**Explanation:**  
- Constructors must not have a return type.  
- Your original code had `public void Game(...)` which is a method, not a constructor, so the compiler did not recognize it as a constructor.  
- Changing them to `public Game(...)` fixes the compilation errors and allows the `fromString` method and other code to instantiate `Game` objects correctly.

package game;

import game.pipes.Pipe;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;

import java.util.LinkedList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Random;

/**
 * Class encapsulating the pipe queue.
 */
class PipeQueue {

	/**
	 * Maximum number of pipes to display in the queue.
	 */
	private static final int MAX_GEN_LENGTH = 5;

	@NotNull
	private final LinkedList<Pipe> pipeQueue;

	/**
	 * Displays the current queue.
	 */
	void display() {
		System.out.print("Next Pipes:  ");
		for (var p : pipeQueue) {
			System.out.print(p.toSingleChar() + "    ");
		}
		System.out.println();
	}

	/**
	 * Generates a new pipe.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * Hint: Use {@link java.util.Random#nextInt(int)} to generate random numbers.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @return A new pipe.
	 */
	private static Pipe generateNewPipe() {
		// TODO
	}

	void PipeQueue() {
		pipeQueue = new LinkedList<>();
		while (pipeQueue.size() < MAX_GEN_LENGTH) {
			pipeQueue.add(generateNewPipe());
		}
	}

	void PipeQueue(List<Pipe> pipes) {
		pipeQueue = new LinkedList<>(pipes);
		while (pipeQueue.size() < MAX_GEN_LENGTH) {
			pipeQueue.add(generateNewPipe());
		}
	}

	Pipe peek() {
		if (pipeQueue.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalStateException("No pipes in the queue.");
		}
		return pipeQueue.getFirst();
	}

	void consume() {
		if (!pipeQueue.isEmpty()) {
			pipeQueue.removeFirst();
		}
		while (pipeQueue.size() < MAX_GEN_LENGTH) {
			pipeQueue.add(generateNewPipe());
		}
	}

	void undo(final Pipe pipe) {
		pipeQueue.addFirst(pipe);
		if (pipeQueue.size() > MAX_GEN_LENGTH) {
			pipeQueue.removeLast();
		}
	}
}

```java
package game;

import game.pipes.Pipe;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;

import java.util.LinkedList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Random;

/**
 * Class encapsulating the pipe queue.
 */
class PipeQueue {

	/**
	 * Maximum number of pipes to display in the queue.
	 */
	private static final int MAX_GEN_LENGTH = 5;

	@NotNull
	private final LinkedList<Pipe> pipeQueue;

	/**
	 * Displays the current queue.
	 */
	void display() {
		System.out.print("Next Pipes:  ");
		for (var p : pipeQueue) {
			System.out.print(p.toSingleChar() + "    ");
		}
		System.out.println();
	}

	/**
	 * Generates a new pipe.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * Hint: Use {@link java.util.Random#nextInt(int)} to generate random numbers.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @return A new pipe.
	 */
	private static Pipe generateNewPipe() {
		// TODO
	}

	void PipeQueue() {
		pipeQueue = new LinkedList<>();
		while (pipeQueue.size() < MAX_GEN_LENGTH) {
			pipeQueue.add(generateNewPipe());
		}
	}

	void PipeQueue(List<Pipe> pipes) {
		pipeQueue = new LinkedList<>(pipes);
		while (pipeQueue.size() < MAX_GEN_LENGTH) {
			pipeQueue.add(generateNewPipe());
		}
	}

	Pipe peek() {
		if (pipeQueue.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalStateException("No pipes in the queue.");
		}
		return pipeQueue.getFirst();
	}

	void consume() {
		if (!pipeQueue.isEmpty()) {
			pipeQueue.removeFirst();
		}
		while (pipeQueue.size() < MAX_GEN_LENGTH) {
			pipeQueue.add(generateNewPipe());
		}
	}

	void undo(final Pipe pipe) {
		pipeQueue.addFirst(pipe);
		if (pipeQueue.size() > MAX_GEN_LENGTH) {
			pipeQueue.removeLast();
		}
	}
}

```java
package game;

import game.pipes.Pipe;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;

import java.util.LinkedList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Random;

/**
 * Class encapsulating the pipe queue.
 */
class PipeQueue {

	/**
	 * Maximum number of pipes to display in the queue.
	 */
	private static final int MAX_GEN_LENGTH = 5;

	@NotNull
	private final LinkedList<Pipe> pipeQueue;

	/**
	 * Displays the current queue.
	 */
	void display() {
		System.out.print("Next Pipes:  ");
		for (var p : pipeQueue) {
			System.out.print(p.toSingleChar() + "    ");
		}
		System.out.println();
	}

	/**
	 * Generates a new pipe.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * Hint: Use {@link java.util.Random#nextInt(int)} to generate random numbers.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @return A new pipe.
	 */
	private static Pipe generateNewPipe() {
		// TODO
	}

	void PipeQueue() {
		pipeQueue = new LinkedList<>();
		while (pipeQueue.size() < MAX_GEN_LENGTH) {
			pipeQueue.add(generateNewPipe());
		}
	}

	void PipeQueue(List<Pipe> pipes) {
		pipeQueue = new LinkedList<>(pipes);
		while (pipeQueue.size() < MAX_GEN_LENGTH) {
			pipeQueue.add(generateNewPipe());
		}
	}

	Pipe peek() {
		if (pipeQueue.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalStateException("No pipes in the queue.");
		}
		return pipeQueue.getFirst();
	}

	void consume() {
		if (!pipeQueue.isEmpty()) {
			pipeQueue.removeFirst();
		}
		while (pipeQueue.size() < MAX_GEN_LENGTH) {
			pipeQueue.add(generateNewPipe());
		}
	}

	void undo(final Pipe pipe) {
		pipeQueue.addFirst(pipe);
		if (pipeQueue.size() > MAX_GEN_LENGTH) {
			pipeQueue.removeLast();
		}
	}
}

Response Text:---
The constructor `Map(int rows, int cols)` needs to initialize the map grid (`cells`) with walls on the edges, one source tile inside (non-edge cell) pointing into a non-wall cell, and one sink tile on the edge pointing outside the map. The rest of the cells should be empty fillable cells.

Here's a complete implementation of the constructor following the requirements:

```java
public Map(int rows, int cols) {
    if (rows < 3 || cols < 3) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map size must be at least 3x3.");
    }

    this.rows = rows;
    this.cols = cols;
    this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];

    // Fill edges with walls
    for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
        for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
            if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
                cells[r][c] = new Wall(new Coordinate(r, c));
            } else {
                cells[r][c] = new FillableCell(new Coordinate(r, c));
            }
        }
    }

    // Generate source cell info (non-edge cell, direction not pointing into wall)
    TerminationCell.CreateInfo sourceInfo = generateStartCellInfo();
    Coordinate sourceCoord = sourceInfo.coord;
    Direction sourceDir = sourceInfo.direction;

    // Place source cell
    sourceCell = new TerminationCell(sourceCoord, sourceDir, true);
    cells[sourceCoord.row][sourceCoord.col] = sourceCell;

    // Generate sink cell info (edge cell, direction pointing outside map)
    TerminationCell.CreateInfo sinkInfo;
    do {
        sinkInfo = generateEndCellInfo();
    } while (sinkInfo.coord.equals(sourceCoord)); // ensure sink != source

    Coordinate sinkCoord = sinkInfo.coord;
    Direction sinkDir = sinkInfo.direction;

    // Place sink cell
    sinkCell = new TerminationCell(sinkCoord, sinkDir, false);
    cells[sinkCoord.row][sinkCoord.col] = sinkCell;
}
```

**Explanation:**

- The constructor initializes the `cells` array.
- Edges are filled with `Wall` cells.
- Inner cells are initialized as `FillableCell`.

public Map(int rows, int cols) {

        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map size must be at least 3x3.");

    Direction sinkDir = sinkInfo.direction;

    cells[sinkCoord.row][sinkCoord.col] = sinkCell;

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			switch (direction) {
			case UP:
				if (row <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case DOWN:
				if (row >= rows - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case LEFT:
				if (col <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case RIGHT:
				if (col >= cols - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

		final int padLength = Integer.valueOf(rows - 1).toString().length();

		Runnable printColumns = () -> {
			System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));

			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(String.format("%1$" + padLength + "s", i));

				System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));

			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(i);
			}

			System.out.println();
		}

		printColumns.run();
	}

```java
public Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) {
    if (rows < 3 || cols < 3) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map size must be at least 3x3.");
    }
    if (cells == null || cells.length != rows) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array must match the specified rows.");
    }
    for (Cell[] row : cells) {
        if (row == null || row.length != cols) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array must match the specified columns.");
        }
    }

    this.rows = rows;
    this.cols = cols;
    this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];

    TerminationCell foundSource = null;
    TerminationCell foundSink = null;

    for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
        for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
            Cell cell = cells[r][c];
            if (cell == null) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cell at (" + r + "," + c + ") is null.");
            }
            this.cells[r][c] = cell;

            if (cell instanceof TerminationCell tc) {
                boolean isEdge = (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1);
                if (tc.isSource()) {
                    // Source must be non-edge
                    if (isEdge) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source cell cannot be on the edge at (" + r + "," + c + ").");
                    }
                    if (foundSource != null) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple source cells found.");
                    }
                    // Source must not point into a wall
                    Coordinate adj = new Coordinate(r, c).add(tc.getDirection().getOffset());
                    if (!isValidCoordinate(adj) || this.cells[adj.row][adj.col] instanceof Wall) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source cell points into a wall or outside map at (" + r + "," + c + ").");
                    }
                    foundSource = tc;
                } else {
                    // Sink must be on edge
                    if (!isEdge) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink cell must be on the edge at (" + r + "," + c + ").");
                    }
                    // Sink must point outside the map
                    Coordinate adj = new Coordinate(r, c).add(tc.getDirection().getOffset());
                    if (isValidCoordinate(adj)) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink cell must point outside the map at (" + r + "," + c + ").");
                    }
                    if (foundSink != null) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple sink cells found.");
                    }
                    foundSink = tc;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (foundSource == null) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("No source cell found.");
    }
    if (foundSink == null) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("No sink cell found.");
    }

    this.sourceCell = foundSource;
    this.sinkCell = foundSink;
}

private boolean isValidCoordinate(Coordinate coord) {
    return coord.row >= 0 && coord.row < rows && coord.col >= 0 && coord.col < cols;
}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			switch (direction) {
			case UP:
				if (row <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case DOWN:
				if (row >= rows - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case LEFT:
				if (col <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case RIGHT:
				if (col >= cols - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	public void display() {
		final int padLength = Integer.valueOf(rows - 1).toString().length();

		Runnable printColumns = () -> {
			System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
			System.out.print(' ');
			for (int i = 0; i < cols - 2; ++i) {
				System.out.print((char) ('A' + i));
			}
			System.out.println();
		};

		printColumns.run();

		for (int i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(String.format("%1$" + padLength + "s", i));
			} else {
				System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
			}

			Arrays.stream(cells[i]).forEachOrdered(elem -> System.out.print(elem.toSingleChar()));

			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(i);
			}

			System.out.println();
		}

		printColumns.run();
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols) {
		if (rows < 3 || cols < 3) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map size must be at least 3x3.");
		}
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
					cells[r][c] = new Wall(new Coordinate(r, c));
				} else {
					cells[r][c] = new FillableCell(new Coordinate(r, c));
				}
			}
		}
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sourceInfo = generateStartCellInfo();
		Coordinate sourceCoord = sourceInfo.coord;
		Direction sourceDir = sourceInfo.direction;
		sourceCell = new TerminationCell(sourceCoord, sourceDir, true);
		cells[sourceCoord.row][sourceCoord.col] = sourceCell;
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sinkInfo;
		do {
			sinkInfo = generateEndCellInfo();
		} while (sinkInfo.coord.equals(sourceCoord));
		Coordinate sinkCoord = sinkInfo.coord;
		Direction sinkDir = sinkInfo.direction;
		sinkCell = new TerminationCell(sinkCoord, sinkDir, false);
		cells[sinkCoord.row][sinkCoord.col] = sinkCell;
	}
}

boolean tryPlacePipe(int row, int col, Pipe p) {
    // Convert one-based to zero-based indices
    int zeroBasedRow = row - 1;
    int zeroBasedCol = col - 1;

    // Check bounds
    if (zeroBasedRow < 0 || zeroBasedRow >= rows || zeroBasedCol < 0 || zeroBasedCol >= cols) {
        return false;
    }

    Cell cell = cells[zeroBasedRow][zeroBasedCol];

    // Check if cell is FillableCell and does not already have a pipe
    if (cell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell) {
        if (fillableCell.getPipe() == null) {
            fillableCell.setPipe(p);
            return true;
        }
    }

    return false;
}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			switch (direction) {
			case UP:
				if (row <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case DOWN:
				if (row >= rows - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case LEFT:
				if (col <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case RIGHT:
				if (col >= cols - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

			System.out.println();
		}

		printColumns.run();
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols) {
		if (rows < 3 || cols < 3) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map size must be at least 3x3.");
		}
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
					cells[r][c] = new Wall(new Coordinate(r, c));
				} else {
					cells[r][c] = new FillableCell(new Coordinate(r, c));
				}
			}
		}
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sourceInfo = generateStartCellInfo();
		Coordinate sourceCoord = sourceInfo.coord;
		Direction sourceDir = sourceInfo.direction;
		sourceCell = new TerminationCell(sourceCoord, sourceDir, true);
		cells[sourceCoord.row][sourceCoord.col] = sourceCell;
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sinkInfo;
		do {
			sinkInfo = generateEndCellInfo();
		} while (sinkInfo.coord.equals(sourceCoord));
		Coordinate sinkCoord = sinkInfo.coord;
		Direction sinkDir = sinkInfo.direction;
		sinkCell = new TerminationCell(sinkCoord, sinkDir, false);
		cells[sinkCoord.row][sinkCoord.col] = sinkCell;
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) {
		if (rows < 3 || cols < 3) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map size must be at least 3x3.");
		}
		if (cells == null || cells.length != rows) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array must match the specified rows.");
		}
		for (Cell[] row : cells) {
			if (row == null || row.length != cols) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array must match the specified columns.");
			}
		}
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		TerminationCell foundSource = null;
		TerminationCell foundSink = null;
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				Cell cell = cells[r][c];
				if (cell == null) {
					throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cell at (" + r + "," + c + ") is null.");
				}
				this.cells[r][c] = cell;
				if (cell instanceof TerminationCell tc) {
					boolean isEdge = (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1);
					if (tc.isSource()) {
						if (isEdge) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException(
									"Source cell cannot be on the edge at (" + r + "," + c + ").");
						}
						if (foundSource != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple source cells found.");
						}
						Coordinate adj = new Coordinate(r, c).add(tc.getDirection().getOffset());
						if (!isValidCoordinate(adj) || this.cells[adj.row][adj.col] instanceof Wall) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException(
									"Source cell points into a wall or outside map at (" + r + "," + c + ").");
						}
						foundSource = tc;
					} else {
						if (!isEdge) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException(
									"Sink cell must be on the edge at (" + r + "," + c + ").");
						}
						Coordinate adj = new Coordinate(r, c).add(tc.getDirection().getOffset());
						if (isValidCoordinate(adj)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException(
									"Sink cell must point outside the map at (" + r + "," + c + ").");
						}
						if (foundSink != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple sink cells found.");
						}
						foundSink = tc;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if (foundSource == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No source cell found.");
		}
		if (foundSink == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No sink cell found.");
		}
		this.sourceCell = foundSource;
		this.sinkCell = foundSink;
	}
}

									"Source cell cannot be on the edge at (" + r + "," + c + ").");
						}
						if (foundSource != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple source cells found.");

									"Source cell points into a wall or outside map at (" + r + "," + c + ").");

									"Sink cell must be on the edge at (" + r + "," + c + ").");

					}

			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No source cell found.");
		}
		if (foundSink == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No sink cell found.");
		}
		this.sourceCell = foundSource;
		this.sinkCell = foundSink;
	}

	boolean tryPlacePipe(int row, int col, Pipe p) {
		int zeroBasedRow = row - 1;
		int zeroBasedCol = col - 1;
		if (zeroBasedRow < 0 || zeroBasedRow >= rows || zeroBasedCol < 0 || zeroBasedCol >= cols) {
			return false;

			}
		}

	}

Response Text:---
The method `fillTiles(int distance)` should fill all fillable cells (pipes) within the given Manhattan distance from the `sourceCell`. A good approach is to perform a breadth-first search (BFS) starting from the source cell, expanding to adjacent cells step by step until the specified distance is reached. During this process, only fill cells that are fillable and not walls, and keep track of already filled cells to avoid revisiting.

Here is a complete implementation of the `fillTiles` method using BFS:

```java
public void fillTiles(int distance) {
    if (distance < 0 || sourceCell == null) {
        return;
    }

    // Clear previous filled tiles and reset tracking
    filledTiles.clear();

    // Queue for BFS: stores pairs of (Coordinate, currentDistance)
    Queue<Map.Entry<Coordinate, Integer>> queue = new LinkedList<>();
    Coordinate sourceCoord = sourceCell.coord;

    // Start from source cell at distance 0
    queue.add(new AbstractMap.SimpleEntry<>(sourceCoord, 0));
    filledTiles.add(sourceCoord);

    // Mark source cell as filled
    sourceCell.setFilled();

    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        var entry = queue.poll();
        Coordinate current = entry.getKey();
        int dist = entry.getValue();

        if (dist >= distance) {
            continue; // Do not expand beyond the given distance
        }

        // Explore neighbors in 4 directions
        for (Direction dir : Direction.values()) {
            Coordinate neighbor = current.add(dir.getOffset());

            // Check if neighbor coordinate is valid
            if (!isValidCoordinate(neighbor)) {
                continue;
            }

            Cell neighborCell = cells[neighbor.row][neighbor.col];

            // Only fill if cell is fillable and not already filled
            if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell && !filledTiles.contains(neighbor)) {
                // Fill the cell
                fillableCell.setFilled();
                filledTiles.add(neighbor);
                queue.add(new AbstractMap.SimpleEntry<>(neighbor, dist + 1));
            }
            // Also consider TerminationCell if it is the sink cell and within distance
            else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell tc && !filledTiles.contains(neighbor)) {
                // Fill termination cells only if within distance
                tc.setFilled();
                filledTiles.add(neighbor);
                queue.add(new AbstractMap.SimpleEntry<>(neighbor, dist + 1));
            }
        }
    }

    prevFilledDistance = distance;
    prevFilledTiles = filledTiles.size();
}
```

**Explanation:**

- The method uses a BFS starting from the `sourceCell`.
- It keeps track of the distance from the source for each cell.
- Only cells within the given `distance` are filled.
- The `filledTiles` set tracks which cells have been filled to avoid revisiting.
- Both `FillableCell` and `TerminationCell` (like sink) are considered fillable.
- The source cell is filled at the start.
- The method updates `prevFilledDistance` and `prevFilledTiles` for potential use elsewhere.

This implementation fits well with the existing class design and fulfills the task requirements.

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			switch (direction) {
			case UP:
				if (row <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case DOWN:
				if (row >= rows - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case LEFT:
				if (col <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case RIGHT:
				if (col >= cols - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

		final int padLength = Integer.valueOf(rows - 1).toString().length();

		Runnable printColumns = () -> {
			System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
			System.out.print(' ');
			for (int i = 0; i < cols - 2; ++i) {
				System.out.print((char) ('A' + i));
			}
			System.out.println();
		};

		printColumns.run();

		for (int i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(String.format("%1$" + padLength + "s", i));
			} else {
				System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
			}

			Arrays.stream(cells[i]).forEachOrdered(elem -> System.out.print(elem.toSingleChar()));

			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(i);
			}

			System.out.println();
		}

		printColumns.run();
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols) {
		if (rows < 3 || cols < 3) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map size must be at least 3x3.");
		}
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
					cells[r][c] = new Wall(new Coordinate(r, c));
				} else {
					cells[r][c] = new FillableCell(new Coordinate(r, c));
				}
			}
		}
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sourceInfo = generateStartCellInfo();
		Coordinate sourceCoord = sourceInfo.coord;
		Direction sourceDir = sourceInfo.direction;
		sourceCell = new TerminationCell(sourceCoord, sourceDir, true);
		cells[sourceCoord.row][sourceCoord.col] = sourceCell;
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sinkInfo;
		do {
			sinkInfo = generateEndCellInfo();
		} while (sinkInfo.coord.equals(sourceCoord));
		Coordinate sinkCoord = sinkInfo.coord;
		Direction sinkDir = sinkInfo.direction;
		sinkCell = new TerminationCell(sinkCoord, sinkDir, false);
		cells[sinkCoord.row][sinkCoord.col] = sinkCell;
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) {
		if (rows < 3 || cols < 3) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map size must be at least 3x3.");
		}
		if (cells == null || cells.length != rows) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array must match the specified rows.");
		}
		for (Cell[] row : cells) {
			if (row == null || row.length != cols) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array must match the specified columns.");
			}
		}
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		TerminationCell foundSource = null;
		TerminationCell foundSink = null;
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				Cell cell = cells[r][c];
				if (cell == null) {
					throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cell at (" + r + "," + c + ") is null.");
				}
				this.cells[r][c] = cell;
				if (cell instanceof TerminationCell tc) {
					boolean isEdge = (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1);
					if (tc.isSource()) {
						if (isEdge) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException(
									"Source cell cannot be on the edge at (" + r + "," + c + ").");
						}
						if (foundSource != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple source cells found.");
						}
						Coordinate adj = new Coordinate(r, c).add(tc.getDirection().getOffset());
						if (!isValidCoordinate(adj) || this.cells[adj.row][adj.col] instanceof Wall) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException(
									"Source cell points into a wall or outside map at (" + r + "," + c + ").");
						}
						foundSource = tc;
					} else {
						if (!isEdge) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException(
									"Sink cell must be on the edge at (" + r + "," + c + ").");
						}
						Coordinate adj = new Coordinate(r, c).add(tc.getDirection().getOffset());
						if (isValidCoordinate(adj)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException(
									"Sink cell must point outside the map at (" + r + "," + c + ").");
						}
						if (foundSink != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple sink cells found.");
						}
						foundSink = tc;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if (foundSource == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No source cell found.");
		}
		if (foundSink == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No sink cell found.");
		}
		this.sourceCell = foundSource;
		this.sinkCell = foundSink;
	}

	boolean tryPlacePipe(int row, int col, Pipe p) {
		int zeroBasedRow = row - 1;
		int zeroBasedCol = col - 1;
		if (zeroBasedRow < 0 || zeroBasedRow >= rows || zeroBasedCol < 0 || zeroBasedCol >= cols) {
			return false;
		}
		Cell cell = cells[zeroBasedRow][zeroBasedCol];
		if (cell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell) {
			if (fillableCell.getPipe() == null) {
				fillableCell.setPipe(p);
				return true;
			}
		}
		return false;
	}

	public void undo(final Coordinate coord) {
		Cell cell = cells[coord.row][coord.col];
		if (!(cell instanceof FillableCell)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cell at " + coord + " is not an instance of FillableCell.");
		}
		cells[coord.row][coord.col] = new FillableCell(coord);
	}

Response Text:---
The `checkPath` method should determine if there is a valid path from the `sourceCell` to the `sinkCell` by traversing through connected pipes and cells. A Breadth First Search (BFS) is a suitable approach here: starting from the source cell, explore all reachable neighboring cells that are connected properly by pipes until the sink cell is found or no more cells can be visited.

Key points for the BFS:
- Start from `sourceCell.coord`.
- For each cell, check all four directions.
- A move to a neighbor is valid if:
  - The neighbor coordinate is within bounds.
  - The current cell and the neighbor cell have pipes that connect in the direction of movement.
  - The neighbor cell is not a Wall.
- If the sink cell is reached during BFS, return true.
- If BFS ends without reaching sink, return false.

Here is a complete implementation of the `checkPath` method:

```java
public boolean checkPath() {
    if (sourceCell == null || sinkCell == null) {
        return false;
    }

    Set<Coordinate> visited = new HashSet<>();
    Queue<Coordinate> queue = new LinkedList<>();
    queue.add(sourceCell.coord);
    visited.add(sourceCell.coord);

    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();
        if (current.equals(sinkCell.coord)) {
            return true;
        }

        Cell currentCell = cells[current.row][current.col];

        for (Direction dir : Direction.values()) {
            Coordinate neighborCoord = current.add(dir.getOffset());
            if (!isValidCoordinate(neighborCoord)) {
                continue;
            }
            if (visited.contains(neighborCoord)) {
                continue;
            }

            Cell neighborCell = cells[neighborCoord.row][neighborCoord.col];
            if (neighborCell instanceof Wall) {
                continue;
            }

            // Check connectivity between currentCell and neighborCell in direction dir
            if (isConnected(currentCell, neighborCell, dir)) {
                visited.add(neighborCoord);
                queue.add(neighborCoord);
            }
        }
    }

    return false;
}

/**
 * Helper method to check if two adjacent cells are connected by pipes in the given direction.
 * @param fromCell The current cell.
 * @param toCell The neighbor cell.
 * @param direction The direction from fromCell to toCell.
 * @return true if the cells are connected, false otherwise.
 */
private boolean isConnected(Cell fromCell, Cell toCell, Direction direction) {
    // Check if fromCell has a pipe or is a TerminationCell that connects in direction
    boolean fromConnects = false;
    if (fromCell instanceof TerminationCell tcFrom) {
        // TerminationCell connects only in its direction
        fromConnects = tcFrom.getDirection() == direction;
    } else if (fromCell instanceof FillableCell fcFrom) {
        Pipe pipe = fcFrom.getPipe();
        if (pipe != null) {
            fromConnects = pipe.connectsTo(direction);
        }
    }

    if (!fromConnects) {
        return false;
    }

    // Check if toCell has a pipe or is a TerminationCell that connects in opposite direction
    Direction opposite = direction.getOpposite();
    boolean toConnects = false;
    if (toCell instanceof TerminationCell tcTo) {
        toConnects = tcTo.getDirection() == opposite;
    } else if (toCell instanceof FillableCell fcTo) {
        Pipe pipe = fcTo.getPipe();
        if (pipe != null) {
            toConnects = pipe.connectsTo(opposite);
        }
    }

    return toConnects;
}
```

**Explanation:**

- We use a BFS starting from the source cell coordinate.
- For each neighbor, we check if the pipes in the current and neighbor cells connect properly in the direction of movement.
- The helper method `isConnected` encapsulates the logic to verify pipe connectivity between two adjacent cells.
- If the sink cell coordinate is reached, return true.
- If BFS finishes without reaching sink, return false.

This implementation assumes that `Pipe` has a method `connectsTo(Direction)` that returns whether the pipe connects in the given direction, and that `TerminationCell` connects only in its specified direction. This matches the typical pipe game logic.

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			switch (direction) {
			case UP:
				if (row <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case DOWN:
				if (row >= rows - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case LEFT:
				if (col <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case RIGHT:
				if (col >= cols - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	/**
	 * Displays the current map.

	public void display() {
		final int padLength = Integer.valueOf(rows - 1).toString().length();

		Runnable printColumns = () -> {
			System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
			System.out.print(' ');
			for (int i = 0; i < cols - 2; ++i) {
				System.out.print((char) ('A' + i));
			}
			System.out.println();
		};

		printColumns.run();

		for (int i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(String.format("%1$" + padLength + "s", i));
			} else {
				System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
			}

			Arrays.stream(cells[i]).forEachOrdered(elem -> System.out.print(elem.toSingleChar()));

			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(i);
			}

			System.out.println();
		}

		printColumns.run();
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols) {
		if (rows < 3 || cols < 3) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map size must be at least 3x3.");
		}
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
					cells[r][c] = new Wall(new Coordinate(r, c));
				} else {
					cells[r][c] = new FillableCell(new Coordinate(r, c));
				}
			}
		}
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sourceInfo = generateStartCellInfo();
		Coordinate sourceCoord = sourceInfo.coord;
		Direction sourceDir = sourceInfo.direction;
		sourceCell = new TerminationCell(sourceCoord, sourceDir, true);
		cells[sourceCoord.row][sourceCoord.col] = sourceCell;
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sinkInfo;
		do {
			sinkInfo = generateEndCellInfo();
		} while (sinkInfo.coord.equals(sourceCoord));
		Coordinate sinkCoord = sinkInfo.coord;
		Direction sinkDir = sinkInfo.direction;
		sinkCell = new TerminationCell(sinkCoord, sinkDir, false);
		cells[sinkCoord.row][sinkCoord.col] = sinkCell;
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) {
		if (rows < 3 || cols < 3) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map size must be at least 3x3.");
		}
		if (cells == null || cells.length != rows) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array must match the specified rows.");
		}
		for (Cell[] row : cells) {
			if (row == null || row.length != cols) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array must match the specified columns.");
			}
		}
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		TerminationCell foundSource = null;
		TerminationCell foundSink = null;
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				Cell cell = cells[r][c];
				if (cell == null) {
					throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cell at (" + r + "," + c + ") is null.");
				}
				this.cells[r][c] = cell;
				if (cell instanceof TerminationCell tc) {
					boolean isEdge = (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1);
					if (tc.isSource()) {
						if (isEdge) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException(
									"Source cell cannot be on the edge at (" + r + "," + c + ").");
						}
						if (foundSource != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple source cells found.");
						}
						Coordinate adj = new Coordinate(r, c).add(tc.getDirection().getOffset());
						if (!isValidCoordinate(adj) || this.cells[adj.row][adj.col] instanceof Wall) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException(
									"Source cell points into a wall or outside map at (" + r + "," + c + ").");
						}
						foundSource = tc;
					} else {
						if (!isEdge) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException(
									"Sink cell must be on the edge at (" + r + "," + c + ").");
						}
						Coordinate adj = new Coordinate(r, c).add(tc.getDirection().getOffset());
						if (isValidCoordinate(adj)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException(
									"Sink cell must point outside the map at (" + r + "," + c + ").");
						}
						if (foundSink != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple sink cells found.");
						}
						foundSink = tc;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if (foundSource == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No source cell found.");
		}
		if (foundSink == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No sink cell found.");
		}
		this.sourceCell = foundSource;
		this.sinkCell = foundSink;
	}

	boolean tryPlacePipe(int row, int col, Pipe p) {
		int zeroBasedRow = row - 1;
		int zeroBasedCol = col - 1;
		if (zeroBasedRow < 0 || zeroBasedRow >= rows || zeroBasedCol < 0 || zeroBasedCol >= cols) {
			return false;
		}
		Cell cell = cells[zeroBasedRow][zeroBasedCol];
		if (cell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell) {
			if (fillableCell.getPipe() == null) {
				fillableCell.setPipe(p);
				return true;
			}
		}
		return false;
	}

	public void undo(final Coordinate coord) {
		Cell cell = cells[coord.row][coord.col];
		if (!(cell instanceof FillableCell)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cell at " + coord + " is not an instance of FillableCell.");
		}
		cells[coord.row][coord.col] = new FillableCell(coord);
	}

	public void fillTiles(int distance) {
		if (distance < 0 || sourceCell == null) {
			return;
		}
		filledTiles.clear();
		Queue<Map.Entry<Coordinate, Integer>> queue = new LinkedList<>();
		Coordinate sourceCoord = sourceCell.coord;
		queue.add(new AbstractMap.SimpleEntry<>(sourceCoord, 0));
		filledTiles.add(sourceCoord);
		sourceCell.setFilled();
		while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
			var entry = queue.poll();
			Coordinate current = entry.getKey();
			int dist = entry.getValue();
			if (dist >= distance) {
				continue;
			}
			for (Direction dir : Direction.values()) {
				Coordinate neighbor = current.add(dir.getOffset());
				if (!isValidCoordinate(neighbor)) {
					continue;
				}
				Cell neighborCell = cells[neighbor.row][neighbor.col];
				if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell && !filledTiles.contains(neighbor)) {
					fillableCell.setFilled();
					filledTiles.add(neighbor);
					queue.add(new AbstractMap.SimpleEntry<>(neighbor, dist + 1));
				} else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell tc && !filledTiles.contains(neighbor)) {
					tc.setFilled();
					filledTiles.add(neighbor);
					queue.add(new AbstractMap.SimpleEntry<>(neighbor, dist + 1));
				}
			}
		}
		prevFilledDistance = distance;
		prevFilledTiles = filledTiles.size();
	}
}

- BOT: 
public boolean checkPath() {
    if (sourceCell == null || sinkCell == null) {
        return false;
    }

    Set<Coordinate> visited = new HashSet<>();
    Queue<Coordinate> queue = new LinkedList<>();
    queue.add(sourceCell.coord);
    visited.add(sourceCell.coord);

    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();
        if (current.equals(sinkCell.coord)) {
            return true;
        }

        Cell currentCell = cells[current.row][current.col];

        for (Direction dir : Direction.values()) {
            Coordinate neighborCoord = current.add(dir.getOffset());
            if (!isValidCoordinate(neighborCoord)) {
                continue;
            }
            if (visited.contains(neighborCoord)) {
                continue;
            }

            Cell neighborCell = cells[neighborCoord.row][neighborCoord.col];
            if (neighborCell instanceof Wall) {
                continue;
            }

            // Check connectivity between currentCell and neighborCell in direction dir
            if (isConnected(currentCell, neighborCell, dir)) {
                visited.add(neighborCoord);
                queue.add(neighborCoord);
            }
        }
    }

    return false;
}

/**
 * Helper method to check if two adjacent cells are connected by pipes in the given direction.
 * @param fromCell The current cell.
 * @param toCell The neighbor cell.
 * @param direction The direction from fromCell to toCell.
 * @return true if the cells are connected, false otherwise.
 */
private boolean isConnected(Cell fromCell, Cell toCell, Direction direction) {
    // Check if fromCell has a pipe or is a TerminationCell that connects in direction
    boolean fromConnects = false;
    if (fromCell instanceof TerminationCell tcFrom) {
        // TerminationCell connects only in its direction
        fromConnects = tcFrom.getDirection() == direction;
    } else if (fromCell instanceof FillableCell fcFrom) {
        Pipe pipe = fcFrom.getPipe();
        if (pipe != null) {
            fromConnects = pipe.connectsTo(direction);
        }
    }

    if (!fromConnects) {
        return false;
    }

The hint says the game is lost if no pipes are filled during a round. The class has a field `prevFilledTiles` which stores the number of filled tiles from the previous round, and `filledTiles` which stores the currently filled tiles. If after a round the number of filled tiles did not increase (or is zero), the game is lost.

A correct implementation of `hasLost()` would return true if `prevFilledTiles` equals the current number of filled tiles (meaning no new pipes were filled this round) or if no pipes are filled at all.

Here is the complete method implementation:

```java
/**
 * <p>
 * Hint: The game is lost when a round ends and no pipes are filled during the round. Is
 * there a way to check whether pipes are filled during a round?
 * </p>
 *
 * @return {@code true} if the game is lost.
 */
public boolean hasLost() {
    // The game is lost if no new pipes were filled this round
    return prevFilledTiles == filledTiles.size();
}

	/**
	 * Constructs a map from a map string.

	 * This is a convenience method for unit testing.

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			switch (direction) {
			case UP:
				if (row <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case DOWN:
				if (row >= rows - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case LEFT:
				if (col <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case RIGHT:
				if (col >= cols - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	public void display() {
		final int padLength = Integer.valueOf(rows - 1).toString().length();

		Runnable printColumns = () -> {

				System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));

			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {

			}

			System.out.println();
		}

		printColumns.run();
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols) {
		if (rows < 3 || cols < 3) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map size must be at least 3x3.");
		}
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
					cells[r][c] = new Wall(new Coordinate(r, c));
				} else {
					cells[r][c] = new FillableCell(new Coordinate(r, c));
				}
			}
		}
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sourceInfo = generateStartCellInfo();
		Coordinate sourceCoord = sourceInfo.coord;
		Direction sourceDir = sourceInfo.direction;
		sourceCell = new TerminationCell(sourceCoord, sourceDir, true);
		cells[sourceCoord.row][sourceCoord.col] = sourceCell;
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sinkInfo;
		do {
			sinkInfo = generateEndCellInfo();
		} while (sinkInfo.coord.equals(sourceCoord));
		Coordinate sinkCoord = sinkInfo.coord;
		Direction sinkDir = sinkInfo.direction;
		sinkCell = new TerminationCell(sinkCoord, sinkDir, false);
		cells[sinkCoord.row][sinkCoord.col] = sinkCell;
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) {
		if (rows < 3 || cols < 3) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map size must be at least 3x3.");
		}
		if (cells == null || cells.length != rows) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array must match the specified rows.");
		}
		for (Cell[] row : cells) {
			if (row == null || row.length != cols) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array must match the specified columns.");
			}
		}
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		TerminationCell foundSource = null;
		TerminationCell foundSink = null;
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				Cell cell = cells[r][c];
				if (cell == null) {
					throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cell at (" + r + "," + c + ") is null.");
				}
				this.cells[r][c] = cell;
				if (cell instanceof TerminationCell tc) {
					boolean isEdge = (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1);
					if (tc.isSource()) {
						if (isEdge) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException(
									"Source cell cannot be on the edge at (" + r + "," + c + ").");
						}
						if (foundSource != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple source cells found.");
						}
						Coordinate adj = new Coordinate(r, c).add(tc.getDirection().getOffset());
						if (!isValidCoordinate(adj) || this.cells[adj.row][adj.col] instanceof Wall) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException(
									"Source cell points into a wall or outside map at (" + r + "," + c + ").");
						}
						foundSource = tc;
					} else {
						if (!isEdge) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException(
									"Sink cell must be on the edge at (" + r + "," + c + ").");
						}
						Coordinate adj = new Coordinate(r, c).add(tc.getDirection().getOffset());
						if (isValidCoordinate(adj)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException(
									"Sink cell must point outside the map at (" + r + "," + c + ").");
						}
						if (foundSink != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple sink cells found.");
						}
						foundSink = tc;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if (foundSource == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No source cell found.");
		}
		if (foundSink == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No sink cell found.");
		}
		this.sourceCell = foundSource;
		this.sinkCell = foundSink;
	}

	boolean tryPlacePipe(int row, int col, Pipe p) {
		int zeroBasedRow = row - 1;
		int zeroBasedCol = col - 1;
		if (zeroBasedRow < 0 || zeroBasedRow >= rows || zeroBasedCol < 0 || zeroBasedCol >= cols) {
			return false;
		}
		Cell cell = cells[zeroBasedRow][zeroBasedCol];
		if (cell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell) {
			if (fillableCell.getPipe() == null) {
				fillableCell.setPipe(p);
				return true;
			}
		}
		return false;
	}

	public void undo(final Coordinate coord) {
		Cell cell = cells[coord.row][coord.col];
		if (!(cell instanceof FillableCell)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cell at " + coord + " is not an instance of FillableCell.");
		}
		cells[coord.row][coord.col] = new FillableCell(coord);
	}

	public void fillTiles(int distance) {
		if (distance < 0 || sourceCell == null) {
			return;
		}
		filledTiles.clear();
		Queue<Map.Entry<Coordinate, Integer>> queue = new LinkedList<>();
		Coordinate sourceCoord = sourceCell.coord;
		queue.add(new AbstractMap.SimpleEntry<>(sourceCoord, 0));
		filledTiles.add(sourceCoord);
		sourceCell.setFilled();
		while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
			var entry = queue.poll();
			Coordinate current = entry.getKey();
			int dist = entry.getValue();
			if (dist >= distance) {
				continue;
			}
			for (Direction dir : Direction.values()) {
				Coordinate neighbor = current.add(dir.getOffset());
				if (!isValidCoordinate(neighbor)) {
					continue;
				}
				Cell neighborCell = cells[neighbor.row][neighbor.col];
				if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell && !filledTiles.contains(neighbor)) {
					fillableCell.setFilled();
					filledTiles.add(neighbor);
					queue.add(new AbstractMap.SimpleEntry<>(neighbor, dist + 1));
				} else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell tc && !filledTiles.contains(neighbor)) {
					tc.setFilled();
					filledTiles.add(neighbor);
					queue.add(new AbstractMap.SimpleEntry<>(neighbor, dist + 1));
				}
			}
		}
		prevFilledDistance = distance;
		prevFilledTiles = filledTiles.size();
	}

	public boolean checkPath() {
		if (sourceCell == null || sinkCell == null) {
			return false;
		}
		Set<Coordinate> visited = new HashSet<>();
		Queue<Coordinate> queue = new LinkedList<>();
		queue.add(sourceCell.coord);
		visited.add(sourceCell.coord);
		while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
			Coordinate current = queue.poll();
			if (current.equals(sinkCell.coord)) {
				return true;
			}
			Cell currentCell = cells[current.row][current.col];
			for (Direction dir : Direction.values()) {
				Coordinate neighborCoord = current.add(dir.getOffset());
				if (!isValidCoordinate(neighborCoord)) {
					continue;
				}
				if (visited.contains(neighborCoord)) {
					continue;
				}
				Cell neighborCell = cells[neighborCoord.row][neighborCoord.col];
				if (neighborCell instanceof Wall) {
					continue;
				}
				if (isConnected(currentCell, neighborCell, dir)) {
					visited.add(neighborCoord);
					queue.add(neighborCoord);
				}
			}
		}
		return false;
	}
}
