Response Text:---
The errors indicate that the methods `getRows()`, `getCols()` do not exist in `Configuration`, `getRow()`, `getCol()` do not exist in `Place`, and `getPieceAt(Place)` does not exist in `Game`. You need to use the correct methods provided by these classes/interfaces. Usually, `Place` has `row()` and `col()` methods (record style), `Game` may have a method like `getPiece(Place)`, and `Configuration` may have methods like `rows()` and `cols()`.

Here is a corrected version of the method using typical naming conventions for such APIs:

```java
@Override
public Move[] getAvailableMoves(Game game, Place source) {
    var moves = new ArrayList<Move>();
    var config = game.getConfiguration();
    int rows = config.rows();
    int cols = config.cols();

    int srcRow = source.row();
    int srcCol = source.col();

    // Directions: up, down, left, right
    int[][] directions = { { -1, 0 }, { 1, 0 }, { 0, -1 }, { 0, 1 } };

    for (int[] dir : directions) {
        int dRow = dir[0];
        int dCol = dir[1];

        int r = srcRow + dRow;
        int c = srcCol + dCol;

        // Step 1: Move forward until find the first piece (the "screen")
        boolean screenFound = false;
        while (r >= 0 && r < rows && c >= 0 && c < cols) {
            Place currentPlace = new Place(r, c);
            if (game.getPiece(currentPlace) != null) {
                screenFound = true;
                break;
            }
            r += dRow;
            c += dCol;
        }

        if (!screenFound) {
            // No screen found in this direction, no valid capture moves beyond
            continue;
        }

        // Step 2: After the screen, move forward to find valid capture moves
        r += dRow;
        c += dCol;
        while (r >= 0 && r < rows && c >= 0 && c < cols) {
            Place targetPlace = new Place(r, c);
            Move move = new Move(source, targetPlace);

            if (validateMove(game, move)) {
                moves.add(move);
            }

            // If there is a piece at targetPlace, cannot jump further
            if (game.getPiece(targetPlace) != null) {
                break;
            }

            r += dRow;
            c += dCol;
        }
    }

    return moves.toArray(Move[]::new);
}
```

This version uses `rows()`, `cols()` for configuration, `row()`, `col()` for place, and `getPiece(Place)` for game, which should fix the compilation errors.

```java
@Override
public Move[] getAvailableMoves(Game game, Place source) {
    var moves = new ArrayList<Move>();
    var config = game.getConfiguration();
```
```java
    int rows = config.rows();
    int cols = config.cols();

    int srcRow = source.row();
    int srcCol = source.col();

    // Directions: up, down, left, right
    int[][] directions = { { -1, 0 }, { 1, 0 }, { 0, -1 }, { 0, 1 } };

    for (int[] dir : directions) {
        int dRow = dir[0];
        int dCol = dir[1];

        int r = srcRow + dRow;
        int c = srcCol + dCol;

        // Step 1: Move forward until find the first piece (the "screen")
        boolean screenFound = false;
        while (r >= 0 && r < rows && c >= 0 && c < cols) {
            Place currentPlace = new Place(r, c);
            if (game.getPiece(currentPlace) != null) {
                screenFound = true;
                break;
            }
            r += dRow;
            c += dCol;
        }

        if (!screenFound) {
            // No screen found in this direction, no valid capture moves beyond
            continue;
        }

        // Step 2: After the screen, move forward to find valid capture moves
        r += dRow;
        c += dCol;
        while (r >= 0 && r < rows && c >= 0 && c < cols) {
            Place targetPlace = new Place(r, c);
            Move move = new Move(source, targetPlace);

            if (validateMove(game, move)) {
                moves.add(move);
            }

            // If there is a piece at targetPlace, cannot jump further
            if (game.getPiece(targetPlace) != null) {
                break;
            }

            r += dRow;
            c += dCol;
        }
    }

    return moves.toArray(Move[]::new);
}
```

Response Text:---
The `validate` method should check if the move made by an Archer piece is valid according to its moving rules, which are similar to the cannon in Xiangqi. Typically, an Archer moves like a rook (horizontally or vertically) but can only capture by jumping exactly one piece (the "screen") between source and target.

A correct implementation should:
- Verify the move is strictly horizontal or vertical.
- Count the number of pieces between source and target.
- Allow a move without capture only if no pieces are in between.
- Allow a capture only if exactly one piece is in between.

Here is a complete implementation of the `validate` method:

```java
@Override
public boolean validate(Game game, Move move) {
    if (!(game.getPiece(move.getSource()) instanceof Archer)) {
        return true;
    }

    var source = move.getSource();
    var target = move.getTarget();

    int srcRow = source.getRow();
    int srcCol = source.getColumn();
    int tgtRow = target.getRow();
    int tgtCol = target.getColumn();

    // Check if move is strictly horizontal or vertical
    if (srcRow != tgtRow && srcCol != tgtCol) {
        return false;
    }

    int countBetween = 0;

    if (srcRow == tgtRow) {
        // Horizontal move
        int start = Math.min(srcCol, tgtCol) + 1;
        int end = Math.max(srcCol, tgtCol);
        for (int c = start; c < end; c++) {
            if (game.getPiece(source.withColumn(c)) != null) {
                countBetween++;
            }
        }
    } else {
        // Vertical move
        int start = Math.min(srcRow, tgtRow) + 1;
        int end = Math.max(srcRow, tgtRow);
        for (int r = start; r < end; r++) {
            if (game.getPiece(source.withRow(r)) != null) {
                countBetween++;
            }
        }
    }

    var targetPiece = game.getPiece(target);

    if (targetPiece == null) {
        // Move without capture: no pieces in between allowed
        return countBetween == 0;
    } else {
        // Capture move: exactly one piece in between required
        return countBetween == 1 && !targetPiece.getOwner().equals(game.getPiece(source).getOwner());
    }
}
```

This method assumes that `source.withRow(int)` and `source.withColumn(int)` return a new position with the given row or column, and that `getPiece(Position)` returns null if no piece is present. It also assumes pieces have an `getOwner()` method to check ownership. Adjust accordingly if your API differs.

The `validate` method should check if the move made by a Knight piece is valid according to chess rules. A Knight moves in an "L" shape: two squares in one direction (horizontal or vertical) and then one square perpendicular to that. The method should calculate the difference in rows and columns between the source and destination positions and verify if it matches the Knight's move pattern.

Here is a complete implementation of the `validate` method for the `KnightMoveRule` class:

```java
@Override
public boolean validate(Game game, Move move) {
    if (!(game.getPiece(move.getSource()) instanceof Knight)) {
        return true;
    }

    int sourceRow = move.getSource().getRow();
    int sourceCol = move.getSource().getCol();
    int destRow = move.getDestination().getRow();
    int destCol = move.getDestination().getCol();

    int rowDiff = Math.abs(destRow - sourceRow);
    int colDiff = Math.abs(destCol - sourceCol);

    // Knight moves in an L shape: 2 by 1 or 1 by 2
    return (rowDiff == 2 && colDiff == 1) || (rowDiff == 1 && colDiff == 2);
}
```

This method returns `true` if the move is a valid Knight move, otherwise `false`.

A common approach is that `Place` might have methods like `getRank()` and `getFile()` (chess terminology), or it might encode position as a single integer or string.

Assuming `Place` has a method `toIndex()` that returns an integer index from 0 to 63 (for an 8x8 board), you can convert that to row and column by division and modulo.

Here is a safe generic approach assuming `Place` has a method `toIndex()`:

```java
@Override
public boolean validate(Game game, Move move) {
    if (!(game.getPiece(move.getSource()) instanceof Knight)) {
        return true;
    }

    int sourceIndex = move.getSource().toIndex();
    int destIndex = move.getDestination().toIndex();

    int sourceRow = sourceIndex / 8;
    int sourceCol = sourceIndex % 8;
    int destRow = destIndex / 8;
    int destCol = destIndex % 8;

    int rowDiff = Math.abs(destRow - sourceRow);
    int colDiff = Math.abs(destCol - sourceCol);

    // Knight moves in an L shape: 2 by 1 or 1 by 2
    return (rowDiff == 2 && colDiff == 1) || (rowDiff == 1 && colDiff == 2);
}
```

If `toIndex()` does not exist, please check the actual API of `Place` and provide it. This is the typical way to handle chess board positions internally.

Response Text:---
The `validate` method should check if the knight's move is blocked by another piece according to the "horse leg" rule in Xiangqi (Chinese chess). A knight moves one step orthogonally and then one step diagonally outward. The move is blocked if there is a piece immediately adjacent orthogonally in the direction of the first step.

To implement this, you need to:
1. Determine the move vector (dx, dy).
2. Identify the orthogonal step (the "leg" position) that must be free.
3. Check if there is any piece at that "leg" position.
4. Return false if blocked, true otherwise.

Here is a complete implementation of the `validate` method:

```java
@Override
public boolean validate(Game game, Move move) {
    if (!(game.getPiece(move.getSource()) instanceof Knight)) {
        return true;
    }

    Place source = move.getSource();
    Place target = move.getTarget();

    int dx = target.getX() - source.getX();
    int dy = target.getY() - source.getY();

    // Knight moves in an "L" shape: 2 by 1 or 1 by 2
    if (!((Math.abs(dx) == 2 && Math.abs(dy) == 1) || (Math.abs(dx) == 1 && Math.abs(dy) == 2))) {
        return false; // invalid knight move shape
    }

    // Determine the blocking position ("leg")
    Place leg;
    if (Math.abs(dx) == 2) {
        // horizontal move first, check the intermediate horizontal step
        leg = new Place(source.getX() + dx / 2, source.getY());
    } else {
        // vertical move first, check the intermediate vertical step
        leg = new Place(source.getX(), source.getY() + dy / 2);
    }

    // If there is a piece blocking the "leg", the move is invalid
    return game.getPiece(leg) == null;
}
```

This method ensures the knight's move is valid only if the blocking position is empty.

public boolean validate(Game game, Move move) {
    if (!(game.getPiece(move.getSource()) instanceof Knight)) {
        return true;
    }

    Place source = move.getSource();
```java
    Place destination = move.getDestination();
```

```java
    int dx = destination.x - source.x;
    int dy = destination.y - source.y;

    // Knight moves in an "L" shape: 2 by 1 or 1 by 2
    if (!((Math.abs(dx) == 2 && Math.abs(dy) == 1) || (Math.abs(dx) == 1 && Math.abs(dy) == 2))) {
        return false; // invalid knight move shape
    }

    // Determine the blocking position ("leg")
    Place leg;
    if (Math.abs(dx) == 2) {
        leg = new Place(source.x + dx / 2, source.y);
    } else {
        leg = new Place(source.x, source.y + dy / 2);

}
```

@Override
```java
public Move nextMove(Game game, Move[] availableMoves) {
    Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
    while (true) {
        System.out.print("Enter your move (e.g. a1->b3): ");
        String input = scanner.nextLine().strip();

        Move move = parseMove(input);
        if (move == null) {
            System.out.println("Invalid format. Please enter move in format like 'a1->b3'.");
            continue;
        }

        // Check if move is in availableMoves
        boolean found = false;
        for (Move m : availableMoves) {
            if (m.equals(move)) {
                found = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (!found) {
            System.out.println("Move not in available moves. Please try again.");
            continue;
        }

        // Validate move rules
        String error = validateMove(game, move);
        if (error != null) {
            System.out.println("Invalid move: " + error);
            continue;
        }

        // Valid move found
        return move;
    }
}
```

```java
package assignment.player;

import assignment.protocol.Game;
import assignment.piece.*;
import assignment.protocol.Color;
import assignment.protocol.Move;
import assignment.protocol.Place;
import assignment.protocol.Player;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;

import java.util.Scanner;

/**
 * The player that makes move according to user input from console.
 */
public class ConsolePlayer extends Player {
	public ConsolePlayer(String name, Color color) {
		super(name, color);
	}

	public ConsolePlayer(String name) {
		this(name, Color.GREEN);
	}

	/**
	 * Choose a move from available moves.
	 * This method will be called by {@link Game} object to get the move that the player wants to make when it is the
	 * player's turn.
	 * <p>
	 * {@link ConsolePlayer} returns a move according to user's input in the console.
	 * The console input format should conform the format described in the assignment description.
	 * (e.g. {@literal a1->b3} means move the {@link Piece} at {@link Place}(x=0,y=0) to {@link Place}(x=1,y=2))
	 * Note that in the {@link Game}.board, the index starts from 0 in both x and y dimension, while in the console
	 * display, x dimension index starts from 'a' and y dimension index starts from 1.
	 * <p>
	 * Hint: be sure to handle invalid input to avoid invalid {@link Move}s.
	 * <p>
	 * <strong>Attention: Student should make sure the {@link Move} returned is valid.</strong>
	 * <p>
	 * <strong>Attention: {@link Place} object uses integer as index of x and y-axis, both starting from 0 to
	 * facilitate programming.
	 * This is VERY different from the coordinate used in console display.</strong>
	 *
	 * @param game           the current game object
	 * @param availableMoves available moves for this player to choose from.
	 * @return the chosen move
	 */
	@Override
	public Move nextMove(Game game, Move[] availableMoves) {
		// TODO student implementation
		return availableMoves[0];
	}

	private String validateMove(Game game, Move move) {
		var rules = new Rule[] { new OutOfBoundaryRule(), new OccupiedRule(), new VacantRule(), new NilMoveRule(),
				new FirstNMovesProtectionRule(game.getConfiguration().getNumMovesProtection()), new ArcherMoveRule(),
				new KnightMoveRule(), new KnightBlockRule(), };
		for (var rule : rules) {
			if (!rule.validate(game, move)) {
				return rule.getDescription();
			}

			var piece = game.getPiece(move.getSource());
			if (piece == null) {
				return "No piece at " + move.getSource().toString();
			}
			if (!this.equals(piece.getPlayer())) {
				return "Cannot move a piece not belonging to you";
			}
		}
		return null;
	}

	private static Place parsePlace(String str) {
		if (str.length() < 2) {
			return null;
		}
		try {
			var x = str.charAt(0) - 'a';
			var y = Integer.parseInt(str.substring(1)) - 1;
			return new Place(x, y);
		} catch (NumberFormatException e) {
			return null;
		}
	}

	private static Move parseMove(String str) {
		var segments = str.split("->");
		if (segments.length < 2) {
			return null;
		}
		var source = parsePlace(segments[0].strip());
		if (source == null) {
			return null;
		}
		var destination = parsePlace(segments[1].strip());
		if (destination == null) {
			return null;
		}
		return new Move(source, destination);
	}
}
```

```java
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @param prevMove The {@link MoveResult} object to revert.

	/**
	 * Tries to move the player from a position in the specified direction as far as possible.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * Note that this method does <b>NOT</b> actually move the player. It just tries to move the player and return
	 * the state of the player as-if it has been moved.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @param position  The original position of the player.
	 * @param direction The direction to move the player in.
	 * @return An instance of {@link MoveResult} representing the type of the move and the position of the player after
	 * moving.
	 */
	@NotNull
	private MoveResult tryMove(@NotNull final Position position, @NotNull final Direction direction) {
		Objects.requireNonNull(position);
		Objects.requireNonNull(direction);

		final var collectedGems = new ArrayList<Position>();
		final var collectedExtraLives = new ArrayList<Position>();
		Position lastValidPosition = position;
		do {
			final Position newPosition = offsetPosition(lastValidPosition, direction);
			if (newPosition == null) {
				break;
			}

			lastValidPosition = newPosition;

			if (gameBoard.getCell(newPosition) instanceof StopCell) {
				break;
			}

			if (gameBoard.getCell(newPosition) instanceof EntityCell entityCell) {
				if (entityCell.getEntity() instanceof Mine) {
					return new MoveResult.Valid.Dead(position, newPosition);
				}

				if (entityCell.getEntity() instanceof Gem) {
					collectedGems.add(newPosition);
				} else if (entityCell.getEntity() instanceof ExtraLife) {
					collectedExtraLives.add(newPosition);
				}
			}
		} while (true);

		if (lastValidPosition.equals(position)) {
			return new MoveResult.Invalid(position);
		}

		return new MoveResult.Valid.Alive(lastValidPosition, position, collectedGems, collectedExtraLives);
	}

	/**
	 * Offsets the {@link Position} in the specified {@link Direction} by one step.
	 *
	 * @param position  The original position.
	 * @param direction The direction to offset.
	 * @return The given position offset by one in the specified direction. If the new position is outside of the game
	 * board, or contains a non-{@link EntityCell}, returns {@code null}.
	 */
	@Nullable
	private Position offsetPosition(@NotNull final Position position, @NotNull final Direction direction) {
		Objects.requireNonNull(position);
		Objects.requireNonNull(direction);

		final var newPos = position.offsetByOrNull(direction.getOffset(), gameBoard.getNumRows(),
				gameBoard.getNumCols());

		if (newPos == null) {
			return null;
		}
		if (!(gameBoard.getCell(newPos) instanceof EntityCell)) {
			return null;
		}

		return newPos;
	}
}
```

Response Text:---
The `makeMove` method should attempt to move the player in the given direction using the `tryMove` method. If the move is invalid or results in the player dying, the game board should not be changed and the corresponding `MoveResult` should be returned. If the move is valid and the player remains alive, the game board should be updated accordingly: the player position should be updated, collected gems and extra lives removed from the board, and the player’s extra lives count updated if needed.

Here is a complete implementation of the `makeMove` method for the `GameBoardController` class:

```java
public MoveResult makeMove(final Direction direction) {
    Objects.requireNonNull(direction);

    final Position currentPosition = gameBoard.getPlayerPosition();
    final MoveResult moveResult = tryMove(currentPosition, direction);

    if (moveResult instanceof MoveResult.Invalid) {
        // Invalid move, do not mutate the board
        return moveResult;
    }

    if (moveResult instanceof MoveResult.Valid.Dead deadMove) {
        // Player dies after move, do not mutate the board
        return deadMove;
    }

    if (moveResult instanceof MoveResult.Valid.Alive aliveMove) {
        // Valid move and player alive, update the board state

        // Remove player from old position
        gameBoard.setCell(currentPosition, new EmptyCell(currentPosition));

        // Update player position
        gameBoard.setPlayerPosition(aliveMove.newPosition());

        // Place player at new position
        gameBoard.setCell(aliveMove.newPosition(), new EntityCell(aliveMove.newPosition(), gameBoard.getPlayer()));

        // Remove collected gems and extra lives from the board
        for (Position gemPos : aliveMove.collectedGems()) {
            gameBoard.setCell(gemPos, new EmptyCell(gemPos));
        }
        for (Position extraLifePos : aliveMove.collectedExtraLives()) {
            gameBoard.setCell(extraLifePos, new EmptyCell(extraLifePos));
        }

        // Update player's extra lives count
        int extraLivesCollected = aliveMove.collectedExtraLives().size();
        gameBoard.getPlayer().addExtraLives(extraLivesCollected);

        return aliveMove;
    }

    // Fallback, should not reach here
    return moveResult;
}
```

**Explanation:**

- The method first calls `tryMove` to simulate the move.
- If the move is invalid or results in death, it returns immediately without changing the board.
- If the move is valid and alive:
  - It removes the player from the old position.
  - Updates the player position in the `GameBoard`.
  - Places the player entity at the new position.
  - Removes collected gems and extra lives from the board by replacing those cells with empty cells.
  - Updates the player's extra lives count by adding the number of collected extra lives.
- Finally, it returns the `MoveResult.Valid.Alive` instance representing the successful move.

This ensures the game board is only mutated if the move is valid and the player survives.

    if (moveResult instanceof MoveResult.Valid.Dead deadMove) {
        // Player dies after move, do not mutate the board
        return deadMove;

        // Valid move and player alive, update the board state

        gameBoard.setCell(currentPosition, new EmptyCell(currentPosition));

        // Update player position
        gameBoard.setPlayerPosition(aliveMove.newPosition());

        // Place player at new position
        gameBoard.setCell(aliveMove.newPosition(), new EntityCell(aliveMove.newPosition(), gameBoard.getPlayer()));

        // Remove collected gems and extra lives from the board
        for (Position gemPos : aliveMove.collectedGems()) {
            gameBoard.setCell(gemPos, new EmptyCell(gemPos));
        }
        for (Position extraLifePos : aliveMove.collectedExtraLives()) {
            gameBoard.setCell(extraLifePos, new EmptyCell(extraLifePos));
        }

        // Update player's extra lives count
        int extraLivesCollected = aliveMove.collectedExtraLives().size();
        gameBoard.getPlayer().addExtraLives(extraLivesCollected);

        return aliveMove;
    }

    // Fallback, should not reach here
    return moveResult;

The `undoMove` method should revert all changes made by the given `MoveResult`. Since `makeMove` updates the player's position, replaces cells with empty cells for collected gems and extra lives, and adds extra lives to the player, `undoMove` must reverse these steps:

- Reset the player's position to the original position before the move.
- Restore the player's cell at the original position.
- Restore the empty cell at the new position.
- Restore all collected gems and extra lives cells.
- Remove the extra lives added to the player.

Here is a complete implementation of the `undoMove` method:

```java
public void undoMove(final MoveResult prevMove) {
    Objects.requireNonNull(prevMove, "prevMove must not be null");

    if (prevMove instanceof MoveResult.Valid.Alive aliveMove) {
        // Restore player position to original
        Position originalPos = aliveMove.originalPosition();
        Position newPos = aliveMove.newPosition();

        // Set the new position cell back to empty
        gameBoard.setCell(newPos, new EmptyCell(newPos));

        // Restore collected gems
        for (Position gemPos : aliveMove.collectedGems()) {
            gameBoard.setCell(gemPos, new EntityCell(gemPos, new Gem()));
        }

        // Restore collected extra lives
        for (Position extraLifePos : aliveMove.collectedExtraLives()) {
            gameBoard.setCell(extraLifePos, new EntityCell(extraLifePos, new ExtraLife()));
        }

        // Restore player cell at original position
        gameBoard.setCell(originalPos, new EntityCell(originalPos, gameBoard.getPlayer()));

        // Reset player position
        gameBoard.setPlayerPosition(originalPos);

        // Remove extra lives added during the move
        int extraLivesCollected = aliveMove.collectedExtraLives().size();
        gameBoard.getPlayer().removeExtraLives(extraLivesCollected);

    } else if (prevMove instanceof MoveResult.Valid.Dead deadMove) {
        // For a dead move, revert player position and cells similarly
        Position originalPos = deadMove.originalPosition();
        Position newPos = deadMove.newPosition();

        // Set the new position cell back to empty
        gameBoard.setCell(newPos, new EmptyCell(newPos));

        // Restore player cell at original position
        gameBoard.setCell(originalPos, new EntityCell(originalPos, gameBoard.getPlayer()));

        // Reset player position
        gameBoard.setPlayerPosition(originalPos);

        // No extra lives to remove because player died
    }
    // For invalid moves, no changes were made, so nothing to undo
}
```

```java
/**
 * Controller for {@link GameBoard}.
 *
 * <p>
 * This class is responsible for providing high-level operations to mutate a {@link GameBoard}. This should be the only
 * class which mutates the game board; Other classes should use this class to mutate the game board.
 * </p>
 */
public class GameBoardController {

	@NotNull
	private final GameBoard gameBoard;

	/**
	 * Undoes a move by reverting all changes performed by the specified move.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * Hint: Undoing a move is effectively the same as reversing everything you have done to make a move.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @param prevMove The {@link MoveResult} object to revert.
	 */
	public void undoMove(final MoveResult prevMove) {
		// TODO
	}

	/**
	 * Tries to move the player from a position in the specified direction as far as possible.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * Note that this method does <b>NOT</b> actually move the player. It just tries to move the player and return
	 * the state of the player as-if it has been moved.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @param position  The original position of the player.
	 * @param direction The direction to move the player in.
	 * @return An instance of {@link MoveResult} representing the type of the move and the position of the player after
	 * moving.
	 */
	@NotNull
	private MoveResult tryMove(@NotNull final Position position, @NotNull final Direction direction) {
		Objects.requireNonNull(position);
		Objects.requireNonNull(direction);

		final var collectedGems = new ArrayList<Position>();
		final var collectedExtraLives = new ArrayList<Position>();
		Position lastValidPosition = position;
		do {
			final Position newPosition = offsetPosition(lastValidPosition, direction);
			if (newPosition == null) {
				break;
			}

			lastValidPosition = newPosition;

			if (gameBoard.getCell(newPosition) instanceof StopCell) {
				break;
			}

			if (gameBoard.getCell(newPosition) instanceof EntityCell entityCell) {
				if (entityCell.getEntity() instanceof Mine) {
					return new MoveResult.Valid.Dead(position, newPosition);
				}

				if (entityCell.getEntity() instanceof Gem) {
					collectedGems.add(newPosition);
				} else if (entityCell.getEntity() instanceof ExtraLife) {
					collectedExtraLives.add(newPosition);
				}
			}
		} while (true);

		if (lastValidPosition.equals(position)) {
			return new MoveResult.Invalid(position);
		}

		return new MoveResult.Valid.Alive(lastValidPosition, position, collectedGems, collectedExtraLives);
	}

	/**
	 * Offsets the {@link Position} in the specified {@link Direction} by one step.
	 *
	 * @param position  The original position.
	 * @param direction The direction to offset.
	 * @return The given position offset by one in the specified direction. If the new position is outside of the game
	 * board, or contains a non-{@link EntityCell}, returns {@code null}.
	 */
	@Nullable
	private Position offsetPosition(@NotNull final Position position, @NotNull final Direction direction) {
		Objects.requireNonNull(position);
		Objects.requireNonNull(direction);

		final var newPos = position.offsetByOrNull(direction.getOffset(), gameBoard.getNumRows(),
				gameBoard.getNumCols());

		if (newPos == null) {
			return null;
		}
		if (!(gameBoard.getCell(newPos) instanceof EntityCell)) {
			return null;
		}

		return newPos;
	}

	public void GameBoardController(final GameBoard gameBoard) {
		this.gameBoard = Objects.requireNonNull(gameBoard, "gameBoard must not be null");
	}

	public MoveResult makeMove(final Direction direction) {
		Objects.requireNonNull(direction);
		final Position currentPosition = gameBoard.getPlayerPosition();
		final MoveResult moveResult = tryMove(currentPosition, direction);
		if (moveResult instanceof MoveResult.Invalid) {
			return moveResult;
		}
		if (moveResult instanceof MoveResult.Valid.Dead deadMove) {
			return deadMove;
		}
		if (moveResult instanceof MoveResult.Valid.Alive aliveMove) {
			gameBoard.setCell(currentPosition, new EmptyCell(currentPosition));
			gameBoard.setPlayerPosition(aliveMove.newPosition());
			gameBoard.setCell(aliveMove.newPosition(), new EntityCell(aliveMove.newPosition(), gameBoard.getPlayer()));
			for (Position gemPos : aliveMove.collectedGems()) {
				gameBoard.setCell(gemPos, new EmptyCell(gemPos));
			}
			for (Position extraLifePos : aliveMove.collectedExtraLives()) {
				gameBoard.setCell(extraLifePos, new EmptyCell(extraLifePos));
			}
			int extraLivesCollected = aliveMove.collectedExtraLives().size();
			gameBoard.getPlayer().addExtraLives(extraLivesCollected);
			return aliveMove;
		}
		return moveResult;
	}
}
```

```java
public void undoMove(final MoveResult prevMove) {
    Objects.requireNonNull(prevMove, "prevMove must not be null");

    if (prevMove instanceof MoveResult.Valid.Alive aliveMove) {
        Position originalPos = aliveMove.originalPosition();
        Position newPos = aliveMove.newPosition();

        // Clear player's new position
        gameBoard.setCell(newPos, new EmptyCell(newPos));

        // Restore collected gems
        for (Position gemPos : aliveMove.collectedGems()) {
            gameBoard.setCell(gemPos, new EntityCell(gemPos, new Gem()));
        }

        // Restore collected extra lives
        for (Position extraLifePos : aliveMove.collectedExtraLives()) {
            gameBoard.setCell(extraLifePos, new EntityCell(extraLifePos, new ExtraLife()));
        }

        // Restore player at original position
        gameBoard.setCell(originalPos, new EntityCell(originalPos, gameBoard.getPlayer()));
        gameBoard.setPlayerPosition(originalPos);

        // Remove extra lives gained during the move by subtracting
        int extraLivesCollected = aliveMove.collectedExtraLives().size();
        gameBoard.getPlayer().addExtraLives(-extraLivesCollected);

    } else if (prevMove instanceof MoveResult.Valid.Dead deadMove) {
        Position originalPos = deadMove.originalPosition();
        Position newPos = deadMove.newPosition();

        // Clear player's new position
        gameBoard.setCell(newPos, new EmptyCell(newPos));

        // Restore player at original position
        gameBoard.setCell(originalPos, new EntityCell(originalPos, gameBoard.getPlayer()));
        gameBoard.setPlayerPosition(originalPos);

        // No extra lives to remove since player died
    }
    // Invalid moves do not change state, so nothing to undo
}
```

```java
public void undoMove(final MoveResult prevMove) {
    Objects.requireNonNull(prevMove, "prevMove must not be null");

    if (prevMove instanceof MoveResult.Valid.Alive aliveMove) {
        Position oldPos = aliveMove.oldPosition();
        Position newPos = aliveMove.newPosition();

        // Clear player's new position
        gameBoard.setCell(newPos, new pa1.model.EmptyCell(newPos));

        // Restore collected gems
        for (Position gemPos : aliveMove.collectedGems()) {
            gameBoard.setCell(gemPos, new pa1.model.EntityCell(gemPos, new pa1.model.Gem()));
        }

        // Restore collected extra lives
        for (Position extraLifePos : aliveMove.collectedExtraLives()) {
            gameBoard.setCell(extraLifePos, new pa1.model.EntityCell(extraLifePos, new pa1.model.ExtraLife()));
        }

        // Restore player at old position
        gameBoard.setCell(oldPos, new pa1.model.EntityCell(oldPos, gameBoard.getPlayer()));
        gameBoard.setPlayerPosition(oldPos);

        // Remove extra lives gained during the move by adding negative
        int extraLivesCollected = aliveMove.collectedExtraLives().size();
        gameBoard.getPlayer().addExtraLives(-extraLivesCollected);

    } else if (prevMove instanceof MoveResult.Valid.Dead deadMove) {
        Position oldPos = deadMove.oldPosition();
        Position newPos = deadMove.newPosition();

        // Clear player's new position
        gameBoard.setCell(newPos, new pa1.model.EmptyCell(newPos));

        // Restore player at old position
        gameBoard.setCell(oldPos, new pa1.model.EntityCell(oldPos, gameBoard.getPlayer()));
        gameBoard.setPlayerPosition(oldPos);

        // No extra lives to remove since player died
    }
    // Invalid moves do not change state, so nothing to undo
}
```

- Use `oldPosition()` and `newPosition()` as per your `MoveResult` subclasses.  
- Fully qualify `EmptyCell`, `EntityCell`, `Gem`, and `ExtraLife` with `pa1.model.` or import them.  
- Use `gameBoard.setCell(Position, Cell)` correctly.  
- Adjust extra lives by adding a negative number since no remove method exists.

Here is a complete constructor implementation:

```java
public GameBoard(final int numRows, final int numCols, final Cell[][] cells) {
    if (cells == null) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array cannot be null");
    }
    if (numRows != cells.length) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("numRows does not match cells.length");
    }
    if (numCols == 0 || cells[0] == null || numCols != cells[0].length) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("numCols does not match cells[0].length");
    }

    // Deep copy of cells to board
    this.board = new Cell[numRows][numCols];
    for (int r = 0; r < numRows; r++) {
        if (cells[r] == null || cells[r].length != numCols) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("All rows must have length equal to numCols");
        }
        System.arraycopy(cells[r], 0, this.board[r], 0, numCols);
    }

    this.numRows = numRows;
    this.numCols = numCols;

    // Validate single player presence
    this.player = getSinglePlayer();

    // Validate at least one gem exists
    int gemCount = 0;
    for (int r = 0; r < numRows; r++) {
        for (int c = 0; c < numCols; c++) {
            Cell cell = this.board[r][c];
            if (cell instanceof EntityCell ec && ec.getEntity() instanceof Gem) {
                gemCount++;
            }
        }
    }
    if (gemCount == 0) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("There must be at least one gem on the board");
    }

    // Validate all gems are reachable
    if (!isAllGemsReachable()) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Some gems are not reachable by the player");
    }
}
```

```java
/**
 * The main game board of the game.
 *
 * <p>
 * The top-left hand corner of the game board is the "origin" of the board (0, 0).
 * </p>
 */
public final class GameBoard {

	 * Creates an instance using the provided creation parameters.

	 * @param numRows The number of rows in the game board.
	 * @param numCols The number of columns in the game board.

	 *                                      <li>There are some gems which cannot be reached by the player</li>

	public GameBoard(final int numRows, final int numCols, final Cell[][] cells) {
		// TODO
		this.numRows = 0;
		this.numCols = 0;

		this.player = null;

	/**
	 * Checks that a single player exists on the game board, and returns the instance of the player.
	 *
	 * @return The single instance of player on the game board.
	 * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the game board has zero, or more than one player entities.
	 */
	@NotNull
	private Player getSinglePlayer() {
		Player player = null;
		for (final var row : board) {
			for (final var cell : row) {
				if (cell instanceof EntityCell ec && ec.getEntity() instanceof Player p) {
					if (player != null) {
						throw new IllegalArgumentException();
					}

					player = p;
				}
			}
		}

		if (player == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException();
		}

		return player;
	}

	/**
	 * Retrieves the instance of {@link EntityCell} by a position with an offset.
	 *
	 * @param pos    Position.
	 * @param offset Positional offset to apply.
	 * @return An instance of {@link EntityCell}, or {@code null} if the resulting position does not contain an entity
	 * cell.
	 */
	@Nullable
	private Position getEntityCellByOffset(@NotNull final Position pos, @NotNull final PositionOffset offset) {
		final var newPos = pos.offsetByOrNull(offset, getNumRows(), getNumCols());
		if (newPos == null) {
			return null;
		}
		if (getCell(newPos) instanceof Wall) {
			return null;
		}

		return newPos;
	}

	/**
	 * Gets all {@link Position} of cells which the player can stop on from the cell of the {@code initialPosition}.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * A cell is "stoppable" iff the player can stop on the cell with any combination of valid moves.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @param initialPosition The starting position to get all stoppable cells.
	 * @return {@link List} of all positions stoppable from {@code initialPosition}.
	 */
	@NotNull
	private List<Position> getAllStoppablePositions(@NotNull final Position initialPosition) {
		Objects.requireNonNull(initialPosition);

		final List<Position> allStoppablePos = new ArrayList<>();
		final List<Position> posToTraverse = new ArrayList<>();

		posToTraverse.add(initialPosition);

		while (!posToTraverse.isEmpty()) {
			final var nextPos = posToTraverse.remove(posToTraverse.size() - 1);

			if (!(getCell(nextPos) instanceof EntityCell)) {
				continue;
			}
			if (allStoppablePos.contains(nextPos)) {
				continue;
			}
			allStoppablePos.add(nextPos);

			for (@NotNull
			final var dir : Direction.values()) {
				for (int i = 0; i < Math.max(getNumRows(), getNumCols()); ++i) {
					final var posOffset = new PositionOffset(dir.getRowOffset() * i, dir.getColOffset() * i);
					final var posToAdd = getEntityCellByOffset(nextPos, posOffset);

					if (posToAdd == null) {
						final var maxDist = i - 1;
						if (maxDist > 0) {
							final var posOffsetBeforeThis = new PositionOffset(dir.getRowOffset() * maxDist,
									dir.getColOffset() * maxDist);
							final var posBeforeThis = getEntityCellByOffset(nextPos, posOffsetBeforeThis);

							if (posBeforeThis != null && !posToTraverse.contains(posBeforeThis)) {
								posToTraverse.add(posBeforeThis);
							}
						}

						break;
					}

					if (getCell(posToAdd) instanceof StopCell || isBorderCell(posToAdd, dir)) {
						posToTraverse.add(posToAdd);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		return Collections.unmodifiableList(allStoppablePos);
	}

	/**
	 * Gets all {@link Position} of cells which are reachable from the cell of the {@code initialPosition}.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * A cell is reachable iff the player can move over the cell with any combination of valid moves.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @param initialPosition The starting position to get all reachable cells.
	 * @return {@link List} of all positions reachable from {@code initialPosition}.
	 */
	@NotNull
	private List<Position> getAllReachablePositions(@NotNull final Position initialPosition) {
		Objects.requireNonNull(initialPosition);

		final List<Position> allReachablePos = new ArrayList<>();
		final List<Position> allStoppablePos = getAllStoppablePositions(initialPosition);

		for (@NotNull
		final var reachablePos : allStoppablePos) {
			for (@NotNull
			final var dir : Direction.values()) {
				for (int i = 0; i < Math.max(getNumRows(), getNumCols()); ++i) {
					final var posOffset = new PositionOffset(dir.getRowOffset() * i, dir.getColOffset() * i);
					final var posToAdd = getEntityCellByOffset(reachablePos, posOffset);
					if (posToAdd == null) {
						break;
					}

					if (!allReachablePos.contains(posToAdd)) {
						allReachablePos.add(posToAdd);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		return Collections.unmodifiableList(allReachablePos);
	}

	/**
	 * Checks whether the given cell is a border cell with reference to the direction.
	 *
	 * @param cellPos The position of the cell.
	 * @param dir     The direction is moving at.
	 * @return {@code true} if the cell at the specified position is a border cell, i.e. the last cell in the game board
	 * before going out of bounds in the given direction.
	 */
	private boolean isBorderCell(@NotNull final Position cellPos, @NotNull final Direction dir) {
		return switch (dir) {
		case UP -> cellPos.row() == 0;
		case DOWN -> cellPos.row() == getNumRows() - 1;
		case LEFT -> cellPos.col() == 0;
		case RIGHT -> cellPos.col() == getNumCols() - 1;
		};
	}

	/**
	 * Checks whether all gems are reachable from the player's initial position.
	 *
	 * @return {@code true} if all gems are reachable.
	 */
	private boolean isAllGemsReachable() {
		final var expectedNumOfGems = getNumGems();

		final var initialPosition = Objects.requireNonNull(getPlayer().getOwner()).getPosition();
		final var playerReachableCells = getAllReachablePositions(initialPosition);

		int actualNumOfGems = 0;
		for (final var pos : playerReachableCells) {
			final var cell = getCell(pos);
			if (cell instanceof EntityCell ec && ec.getEntity() instanceof Gem) {
				++actualNumOfGems;
			}
		}

		return expectedNumOfGems == actualNumOfGems;
	}
```

```java
 * The main game board of the game.

 * The top-left hand corner of the game board is the "origin" of the board (0, 0).

	/**
	 * Checks that a single player exists on the game board, and returns the instance of the player.
	 *
	 * @return The single instance of player on the game board.
	 * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the game board has zero, or more than one player entities.
	 */
	@NotNull
	private Player getSinglePlayer() {
		Player player = null;
		for (final var row : board) {
			for (final var cell : row) {
				if (cell instanceof EntityCell ec && ec.getEntity() instanceof Player p) {
					if (player != null) {
						throw new IllegalArgumentException();
					}

					player = p;
				}
			}
		}

		if (player == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException();
		}

		return player;
	}

	/**
	 * Retrieves the instance of {@link EntityCell} by a position with an offset.
	 *
	 * @param pos    Position.
	 * @param offset Positional offset to apply.
	 * @return An instance of {@link EntityCell}, or {@code null} if the resulting position does not contain an entity
	 * cell.
	 */
	@Nullable
	private Position getEntityCellByOffset(@NotNull final Position pos, @NotNull final PositionOffset offset) {
		final var newPos = pos.offsetByOrNull(offset, getNumRows(), getNumCols());
		if (newPos == null) {
			return null;
		}
		if (getCell(newPos) instanceof Wall) {
			return null;
		}

		return newPos;

	/**
	 * Gets all {@link Position} of cells which the player can stop on from the cell of the {@code initialPosition}.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * A cell is "stoppable" iff the player can stop on the cell with any combination of valid moves.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @param initialPosition The starting position to get all stoppable cells.
	 * @return {@link List} of all positions stoppable from {@code initialPosition}.
	 */
	@NotNull
	private List<Position> getAllStoppablePositions(@NotNull final Position initialPosition) {
		Objects.requireNonNull(initialPosition);

		final List<Position> allStoppablePos = new ArrayList<>();
		final List<Position> posToTraverse = new ArrayList<>();

		posToTraverse.add(initialPosition);

		while (!posToTraverse.isEmpty()) {
			final var nextPos = posToTraverse.remove(posToTraverse.size() - 1);

			if (!(getCell(nextPos) instanceof EntityCell)) {
				continue;
			}
			if (allStoppablePos.contains(nextPos)) {
				continue;
			}
			allStoppablePos.add(nextPos);

			for (@NotNull
			final var dir : Direction.values()) {
				for (int i = 0; i < Math.max(getNumRows(), getNumCols()); ++i) {
					final var posOffset = new PositionOffset(dir.getRowOffset() * i, dir.getColOffset() * i);
					final var posToAdd = getEntityCellByOffset(nextPos, posOffset);

					if (posToAdd == null) {
						final var maxDist = i - 1;
						if (maxDist > 0) {
							final var posOffsetBeforeThis = new PositionOffset(dir.getRowOffset() * maxDist,
									dir.getColOffset() * maxDist);
							final var posBeforeThis = getEntityCellByOffset(nextPos, posOffsetBeforeThis);

							if (posBeforeThis != null && !posToTraverse.contains(posBeforeThis)) {
								posToTraverse.add(posBeforeThis);
							}
						}

						break;
					}

					if (getCell(posToAdd) instanceof StopCell || isBorderCell(posToAdd, dir)) {
						posToTraverse.add(posToAdd);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		return Collections.unmodifiableList(allStoppablePos);
	}

		final List<Position> allReachablePos = new ArrayList<>();
		final List<Position> allStoppablePos = getAllStoppablePositions(initialPosition);

	private boolean isBorderCell(@NotNull final Position cellPos, @NotNull final Direction dir) {

	public void GameBoard(final int numRows, final int numCols, final Cell[][] cells) {
		if (cells == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array cannot be null");
		}
		if (numRows != cells.length) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("numRows does not match cells.length");
		}
		if (numCols == 0 || cells[0] == null || numCols != cells[0].length) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("numCols does not match cells[0].length");
		}
		this.board = new Cell[numRows][numCols];
		for (int r = 0; r < numRows; r++) {
			if (cells[r] == null || cells[r].length != numCols) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("All rows must have length equal to numCols");
			}
			System.arraycopy(cells[r], 0, this.board[r], 0, numCols);
		}
		this.numRows = numRows;
		this.numCols = numCols;
		this.player = getSinglePlayer();
		int gemCount = 0;
		for (int r = 0; r < numRows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < numCols; c++) {
				Cell cell = this.board[r][c];
				if (cell instanceof EntityCell ec && ec.getEntity() instanceof Gem) {
					gemCount++;
				}
			}
		}
		if (gemCount == 0) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("There must be at least one gem on the board");
		}
		if (!isAllGemsReachable()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Some gems are not reachable by the player");
		}
	}
}
```

```java
public Cell[] getCol(final int col) {
    if (col < 0 || col >= numCols) {
        throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException("Column index out of bounds: " + col);
    }
```

```java
	public void GameBoard(final int numRows, final int numCols, final Cell[][] cells) {
		if (cells == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array cannot be null");
		}
		if (numRows != cells.length) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("numRows does not match cells.length");
		}
		if (numCols == 0 || cells[0] == null || numCols != cells[0].length) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("numCols does not match cells[0].length");
		}
		this.board = new Cell[numRows][numCols];
		for (int r = 0; r < numRows; r++) {
			if (cells[r] == null || cells[r].length != numCols) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("All rows must have length equal to numCols");
			}
			System.arraycopy(cells[r], 0, this.board[r], 0, numCols);
		}
		this.numRows = numRows;
		this.numCols = numCols;
		this.player = getSinglePlayer();
		int gemCount = 0;
		for (int r = 0; r < numRows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < numCols; c++) {
				Cell cell = this.board[r][c];
				if (cell instanceof EntityCell ec && ec.getEntity() instanceof Gem) {
					gemCount++;
				}
			}
		}
		if (gemCount == 0) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("There must be at least one gem on the board");
		}
		if (!isAllGemsReachable()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Some gems are not reachable by the player");
		}
	}

	public Cell[] getRow(final int row) {
		if (row < 0 || row >= numRows) {
			throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException("Row index out of bounds: " + row);
		}
		return board[row].clone();
	}
```

```java
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;

import java.util.List;

/**
 * The main game board of the game.
 *
 * <p>
 * The top-left hand corner of the game board is the "origin" of the board (0, 0).
 * </p>
 */
public final class GameBoard {

	/**
	 * Number of rows in the game board.
	 */
	private final int numRows;
	/**
	 * Number of columns in the game board.
	 */
	private final int numCols;

	/**
	 * 2D array representing each cell in the game board.
	 */
	@NotNull
	private final Cell[][] board;

	/**
	 * The instance of {@link Player} on this game board.
	 */
	@NotNull
	private final Player player;

	/**
	 * Checks that a single player exists on the game board, and returns the instance of the player.
	 *
	 * @return The single instance of player on the game board.
	 * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the game board has zero, or more than one player entities.
	 */
	@NotNull
	private Player getSinglePlayer() {
		Player player = null;
		for (final var row : board) {
			for (final var cell : row) {
				if (cell instanceof EntityCell ec && ec.getEntity() instanceof Player p) {
					if (player != null) {
						throw new IllegalArgumentException();
					}

					player = p;
				}
			}
		}

		if (player == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException();
		}

		return player;
	}

	/**
	 * Retrieves the instance of {@link EntityCell} by a position with an offset.
	 *
	 * @param pos    Position.
	 * @param offset Positional offset to apply.
	 * @return An instance of {@link EntityCell}, or {@code null} if the resulting position does not contain an entity
	 * cell.
	 */
	@Nullable
	private Position getEntityCellByOffset(@NotNull final Position pos, @NotNull final PositionOffset offset) {
		final var newPos = pos.offsetByOrNull(offset, getNumRows(), getNumCols());
		if (newPos == null) {
			return null;
		}
		if (getCell(newPos) instanceof Wall) {
			return null;
		}

		return newPos;
	}

	/**
	 * Gets all {@link Position} of cells which the player can stop on from the cell of the {@code initialPosition}.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * A cell is "stoppable" iff the player can stop on the cell with any combination of valid moves.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @param initialPosition The starting position to get all stoppable cells.
	 * @return {@link List} of all positions stoppable from {@code initialPosition}.
	 */
	@NotNull
	private List<Position> getAllStoppablePositions(@NotNull final Position initialPosition) {
		Objects.requireNonNull(initialPosition);

		final List<Position> allStoppablePos = new ArrayList<>();
		final List<Position> posToTraverse = new ArrayList<>();

		posToTraverse.add(initialPosition);

		while (!posToTraverse.isEmpty()) {
			final var nextPos = posToTraverse.remove(posToTraverse.size() - 1);

			if (!(getCell(nextPos) instanceof EntityCell)) {
				continue;
			}
			if (allStoppablePos.contains(nextPos)) {
				continue;
			}
			allStoppablePos.add(nextPos);

			for (@NotNull
			final var dir : Direction.values()) {
				for (int i = 0; i < Math.max(getNumRows(), getNumCols()); ++i) {
					final var posOffset = new PositionOffset(dir.getRowOffset() * i, dir.getColOffset() * i);
					final var posToAdd = getEntityCellByOffset(nextPos, posOffset);

					if (posToAdd == null) {
						final var maxDist = i - 1;
						if (maxDist > 0) {
							final var posOffsetBeforeThis = new PositionOffset(dir.getRowOffset() * maxDist,
									dir.getColOffset() * maxDist);
							final var posBeforeThis = getEntityCellByOffset(nextPos, posOffsetBeforeThis);

							if (posBeforeThis != null && !posToTraverse.contains(posBeforeThis)) {
								posToTraverse.add(posBeforeThis);
							}
						}

						break;
					}

					if (getCell(posToAdd) instanceof StopCell || isBorderCell(posToAdd, dir)) {
						posToTraverse.add(posToAdd);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		return Collections.unmodifiableList(allStoppablePos);
	}

	/**
	 * Gets all {@link Position} of cells which are reachable from the cell of the {@code initialPosition}.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * A cell is reachable iff the player can move over the cell with any combination of valid moves.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @param initialPosition The starting position to get all reachable cells.
	 * @return {@link List} of all positions reachable from {@code initialPosition}.
	 */
	@NotNull
	private List<Position> getAllReachablePositions(@NotNull final Position initialPosition) {
		Objects.requireNonNull(initialPosition);

		final List<Position> allReachablePos = new ArrayList<>();
		final List<Position> allStoppablePos = getAllStoppablePositions(initialPosition);

		for (@NotNull
		final var reachablePos : allStoppablePos) {
			for (@NotNull
			final var dir : Direction.values()) {
				for (int i = 0; i < Math.max(getNumRows(), getNumCols()); ++i) {
					final var posOffset = new PositionOffset(dir.getRowOffset() * i, dir.getColOffset() * i);
					final var posToAdd = getEntityCellByOffset(reachablePos, posOffset);
					if (posToAdd == null) {
						break;
					}

					if (!allReachablePos.contains(posToAdd)) {
						allReachablePos.add(posToAdd);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		return Collections.unmodifiableList(allReachablePos);
	}

	/**
	 * Checks whether the given cell is a border cell with reference to the direction.
	 *
	 * @param cellPos The position of the cell.
	 * @param dir     The direction is moving at.
	 * @return {@code true} if the cell at the specified position is a border cell, i.e. the last cell in the game board
	 * before going out of bounds in the given direction.
	 */
	private boolean isBorderCell(@NotNull final Position cellPos, @NotNull final Direction dir) {
		return switch (dir) {
		case UP -> cellPos.row() == 0;
		case DOWN -> cellPos.row() == getNumRows() - 1;
		case LEFT -> cellPos.col() == 0;
		case RIGHT -> cellPos.col() == getNumCols() - 1;
		};
	}

	/**
	 * Checks whether all gems are reachable from the player's initial position.
	 *
	 * @return {@code true} if all gems are reachable.

	private boolean isAllGemsReachable() {
		final var expectedNumOfGems = getNumGems();

		final var initialPosition = Objects.requireNonNull(getPlayer().getOwner()).getPosition();
		final var playerReachableCells = getAllReachablePositions(initialPosition);

		int actualNumOfGems = 0;
		for (final var pos : playerReachableCells) {
			final var cell = getCell(pos);
			if (cell instanceof EntityCell ec && ec.getEntity() instanceof Gem) {
				++actualNumOfGems;
			}
		}

		return expectedNumOfGems == actualNumOfGems;
	}

	public void GameBoard(final int numRows, final int numCols, final Cell[][] cells) {
		if (cells == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array cannot be null");
```

```java
		if (getCell(newPos) instanceof Wall) {
			return null;
		}

		return newPos;
	}

	/**
	 * Gets all {@link Position} of cells which the player can stop on from the cell of the {@code initialPosition}.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * A cell is "stoppable" iff the player can stop on the cell with any combination of valid moves.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @param initialPosition The starting position to get all stoppable cells.
	 * @return {@link List} of all positions stoppable from {@code initialPosition}.
	 */
	@NotNull
	private List<Position> getAllStoppablePositions(@NotNull final Position initialPosition) {
		Objects.requireNonNull(initialPosition);

		final List<Position> allStoppablePos = new ArrayList<>();
		final List<Position> posToTraverse = new ArrayList<>();

		posToTraverse.add(initialPosition);

		while (!posToTraverse.isEmpty()) {
			final var nextPos = posToTraverse.remove(posToTraverse.size() - 1);

			if (!(getCell(nextPos) instanceof EntityCell)) {
				continue;
			}
			if (allStoppablePos.contains(nextPos)) {
				continue;
			}
			allStoppablePos.add(nextPos);

			for (@NotNull
			final var dir : Direction.values()) {
				for (int i = 0; i < Math.max(getNumRows(), getNumCols()); ++i) {
					final var posOffset = new PositionOffset(dir.getRowOffset() * i, dir.getColOffset() * i);
					final var posToAdd = getEntityCellByOffset(nextPos, posOffset);

					if (posToAdd == null) {
						final var maxDist = i - 1;
						if (maxDist > 0) {
							final var posOffsetBeforeThis = new PositionOffset(dir.getRowOffset() * maxDist,
									dir.getColOffset() * maxDist);
							final var posBeforeThis = getEntityCellByOffset(nextPos, posOffsetBeforeThis);

							if (posBeforeThis != null && !posToTraverse.contains(posBeforeThis)) {
								posToTraverse.add(posBeforeThis);
							}
						}

						break;
					}

					if (getCell(posToAdd) instanceof StopCell || isBorderCell(posToAdd, dir)) {
						posToTraverse.add(posToAdd);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		return Collections.unmodifiableList(allStoppablePos);
	}

	/**
	 * Gets all {@link Position} of cells which are reachable from the cell of the {@code initialPosition}.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * A cell is reachable iff the player can move over the cell with any combination of valid moves.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @param initialPosition The starting position to get all reachable cells.
	 * @return {@link List} of all positions reachable from {@code initialPosition}.
	 */
	@NotNull
	private List<Position> getAllReachablePositions(@NotNull final Position initialPosition) {
		Objects.requireNonNull(initialPosition);

		final List<Position> allReachablePos = new ArrayList<>();
		final List<Position> allStoppablePos = getAllStoppablePositions(initialPosition);

		for (@NotNull
		final var reachablePos : allStoppablePos) {
			for (@NotNull
			final var dir : Direction.values()) {
				for (int i = 0; i < Math.max(getNumRows(), getNumCols()); ++i) {
					final var posOffset = new PositionOffset(dir.getRowOffset() * i, dir.getColOffset() * i);
					final var posToAdd = getEntityCellByOffset(reachablePos, posOffset);
					if (posToAdd == null) {
						break;
					}

					if (!allReachablePos.contains(posToAdd)) {
						allReachablePos.add(posToAdd);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		return Collections.unmodifiableList(allReachablePos);
	}

	/**
	 * Checks whether the given cell is a border cell with reference to the direction.
	 *
	 * @param cellPos The position of the cell.
	 * @param dir     The direction is moving at.
	 * @return {@code true} if the cell at the specified position is a border cell, i.e. the last cell in the game board
	 * before going out of bounds in the given direction.
	 */
	private boolean isBorderCell(@NotNull final Position cellPos, @NotNull final Direction dir) {
		return switch (dir) {
		case UP -> cellPos.row() == 0;
		case DOWN -> cellPos.row() == getNumRows() - 1;
		case LEFT -> cellPos.col() == 0;
		case RIGHT -> cellPos.col() == getNumCols() - 1;
		};
	}

	/**
	 * Checks whether all gems are reachable from the player's initial position.
	 *
	 * @return {@code true} if all gems are reachable.
	 */
	private boolean isAllGemsReachable() {
		final var expectedNumOfGems = getNumGems();

		final var initialPosition = Objects.requireNonNull(getPlayer().getOwner()).getPosition();
		final var playerReachableCells = getAllReachablePositions(initialPosition);

		int actualNumOfGems = 0;
		for (final var pos : playerReachableCells) {
			final var cell = getCell(pos);
			if (cell instanceof EntityCell ec && ec.getEntity() instanceof Gem) {
				++actualNumOfGems;
			}
		}

		return expectedNumOfGems == actualNumOfGems;
	}

	public void GameBoard(final int numRows, final int numCols, final Cell[][] cells) {
		if (cells == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array cannot be null");
		}
		if (numRows != cells.length) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("numRows does not match cells.length");
		}
		if (numCols == 0 || cells[0] == null || numCols != cells[0].length) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("numCols does not match cells[0].length");
		}
		this.board = new Cell[numRows][numCols];
		for (int r = 0; r < numRows; r++) {
			if (cells[r] == null || cells[r].length != numCols) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("All rows must have length equal to numCols");
			}
			System.arraycopy(cells[r], 0, this.board[r], 0, numCols);
		}
		this.numRows = numRows;
		this.numCols = numCols;
		this.player = getSinglePlayer();
		int gemCount = 0;
		for (int r = 0; r < numRows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < numCols; c++) {
				Cell cell = this.board[r][c];
				if (cell instanceof EntityCell ec && ec.getEntity() instanceof Gem) {
					gemCount++;
				}
			}
		}
		if (gemCount == 0) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("There must be at least one gem on the board");
		}
		if (!isAllGemsReachable()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Some gems are not reachable by the player");
		}
	}

	public Cell[] getRow(final int row) {
		if (row < 0 || row >= numRows) {
			throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException("Row index out of bounds: " + row);
		}
		return board[row].clone();
	}

	public Cell[] getCol(final int col) {
		if (col < 0 || col >= numCols) {
			throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException("Column index out of bounds: " + col);
		}
		Cell[] column = new Cell[numRows];
		for (int row = 0; row < numRows; row++) {
			column[row] = board[row][col];
		}
		return column;
	}

	public Cell getCell(final int row, final int col) {
		if (row < 0 || row >= numRows) {
			throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException("Row index out of bounds: " + row);
		}
		if (col < 0 || col >= numCols) {
			throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException("Column index out of bounds: " + col);
		}
		return board[row][col];
	}
}
```

	 *
```java
	 * @return The single instance of player on the game board.
	 * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the game board has zero, or more than one player entities.
	 */
	@NotNull
	private Player getSinglePlayer() {
		Player player = null;
		for (final var row : board) {
			for (final var cell : row) {
				if (cell instanceof EntityCell ec && ec.getEntity() instanceof Player p) {
					if (player != null) {
						throw new IllegalArgumentException();
					}

					player = p;
				}
			}
		}

		if (player == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException();
		}

	 * cell.

	@Nullable

	public void GameBoard(final int numRows, final int numCols, final Cell[][] cells) {
```

```java
package pa1.model;

import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * The main game board of the game.
 *
 * <p>
 * The top-left hand corner of the game board is the "origin" of the board (0, 0).
 * </p>
 */
public final class GameBoard {

	/**
	 * Number of rows in the game board.
	 */
	private final int numRows;
	/**
	 * Number of columns in the game board.
	 */
	private final int numCols;

	/**
	 * 2D array representing each cell in the game board.
	 */
	@NotNull
	private final Cell[][] board;

	/**
	 * The instance of {@link Player} on this game board.
	 */
	@NotNull
	private final Player player;

	/**
	 * Checks that a single player exists on the game board, and returns the instance of the player.
	 *
	 * @return The single instance of player on the game board.
	 * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the game board has zero, or more than one player entities.
	 */
	@NotNull
	private Player getSinglePlayer() {
		Player player = null;
		for (final var row : board) {
			for (final var cell : row) {
				if (cell instanceof EntityCell ec && ec.getEntity() instanceof Player p) {
					if (player != null) {
						throw new IllegalArgumentException();
					}

					player = p;
				}
			}
		}

		if (player == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException();
		}

		return player;
	}

	/**
	 * Retrieves the instance of {@link EntityCell} by a position with an offset.
	 *
	 * @param pos    Position.
	 * @param offset Positional offset to apply.
	 * @return An instance of {@link EntityCell}, or {@code null} if the resulting position does not contain an entity
	 * cell.
	 */
	@Nullable
	private Position getEntityCellByOffset(@NotNull final Position pos, @NotNull final PositionOffset offset) {
		final var newPos = pos.offsetByOrNull(offset, getNumRows(), getNumCols());
		if (newPos == null) {
			return null;
		}
		if (getCell(newPos) instanceof Wall) {
			return null;
		}

		return newPos;
	}

	/**
	 * Gets all {@link Position} of cells which the player can stop on from the cell of the {@code initialPosition}.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * A cell is "stoppable" iff the player can stop on the cell with any combination of valid moves.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @param initialPosition The starting position to get all stoppable cells.
	 * @return {@link List} of all positions stoppable from {@code initialPosition}.
	 */
	@NotNull
	private List<Position> getAllStoppablePositions(@NotNull final Position initialPosition) {
		Objects.requireNonNull(initialPosition);

		final List<Position> allStoppablePos = new ArrayList<>();
		final List<Position> posToTraverse = new ArrayList<>();

		posToTraverse.add(initialPosition);

		while (!posToTraverse.isEmpty()) {
			final var nextPos = posToTraverse.remove(posToTraverse.size() - 1);

			if (!(getCell(nextPos) instanceof EntityCell)) {
				continue;
			}
			if (allStoppablePos.contains(nextPos)) {
				continue;
			}
			allStoppablePos.add(nextPos);

			for (@NotNull
			final var dir : Direction.values()) {
				for (int i = 0; i < Math.max(getNumRows(), getNumCols()); ++i) {
					final var posOffset = new PositionOffset(dir.getRowOffset() * i, dir.getColOffset() * i);
					final var posToAdd = getEntityCellByOffset(nextPos, posOffset);

					if (posToAdd == null) {
						final var maxDist = i - 1;
						if (maxDist > 0) {
							final var posOffsetBeforeThis = new PositionOffset(dir.getRowOffset() * maxDist,
									dir.getColOffset() * maxDist);
							final var posBeforeThis = getEntityCellByOffset(nextPos, posOffsetBeforeThis);

							if (posBeforeThis != null && !posToTraverse.contains(posBeforeThis)) {
								posToTraverse.add(posBeforeThis);
							}
						}

						break;
					}

					if (getCell(posToAdd) instanceof StopCell || isBorderCell(posToAdd, dir)) {
						posToTraverse.add(posToAdd);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		return Collections.unmodifiableList(allStoppablePos);
	}

	/**
	 * Gets all {@link Position} of cells which are reachable from the cell of the {@code initialPosition}.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * A cell is reachable iff the player can move over the cell with any combination of valid moves.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @param initialPosition The starting position to get all reachable cells.
	 * @return {@link List} of all positions reachable from {@code initialPosition}.
	 */
	@NotNull
	private List<Position> getAllReachablePositions(@NotNull final Position initialPosition) {
		Objects.requireNonNull(initialPosition);

		final List<Position> allReachablePos = new ArrayList<>();
		final List<Position> allStoppablePos = getAllStoppablePositions(initialPosition);

		for (@NotNull
		final var reachablePos : allStoppablePos) {
			for (@NotNull
			final var dir : Direction.values()) {
				for (int i = 0; i < Math.max(getNumRows(), getNumCols()); ++i) {
					final var posOffset = new PositionOffset(dir.getRowOffset() * i, dir.getColOffset() * i);
					final var posToAdd = getEntityCellByOffset(reachablePos, posOffset);
					if (posToAdd == null) {
						break;
					}

					if (!allReachablePos.contains(posToAdd)) {
						allReachablePos.add(posToAdd);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		return Collections.unmodifiableList(allReachablePos);
	}

	/**
	 * Checks whether the given cell is a border cell with reference to the direction.
	 *
	 * @param cellPos The position of the cell.
	 * @param dir     The direction is moving at.
	 * @return {@code true} if the cell at the specified position is a border cell, i.e. the last cell in the game board
	 * before going out of bounds in the given direction.
	 */
	private boolean isBorderCell(@NotNull final Position cellPos, @NotNull final Direction dir) {
		return switch (dir) {
		case UP -> cellPos.row() == 0;
		case DOWN -> cellPos.row() == getNumRows() - 1;
		case LEFT -> cellPos.col() == 0;
		case RIGHT -> cellPos.col() == getNumCols() - 1;
		};
	}

	/**
	 * Checks whether all gems are reachable from the player's initial position.
	 *
	 * @return {@code true} if all gems are reachable.
	 */
	private boolean isAllGemsReachable() {
		final var expectedNumOfGems = getNumGems();

		final var initialPosition = Objects.requireNonNull(getPlayer().getOwner()).getPosition();
		final var playerReachableCells = getAllReachablePositions(initialPosition);

		int actualNumOfGems = 0;
		for (final var pos : playerReachableCells) {
			final var cell = getCell(pos);
			if (cell instanceof EntityCell ec && ec.getEntity() instanceof Gem) {
				++actualNumOfGems;
			}
		}

		return expectedNumOfGems == actualNumOfGems;
	}

	public void GameBoard(final int numRows, final int numCols, final Cell[][] cells) {
		if (cells == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array cannot be null");
		}
		if (numRows != cells.length) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("numRows does not match cells.length");
		}
		if (numCols == 0 || cells[0] == null || numCols != cells[0].length) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("numCols does not match cells[0].length");
		}
		this.board = new Cell[numRows][numCols];
		for (int r = 0; r < numRows; r++) {
			if (cells[r] == null || cells[r].length != numCols) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("All rows must have length equal to numCols");
			}
			System.arraycopy(cells[r], 0, this.board[r], 0, numCols);
		}
		this.numRows = numRows;
		this.numCols = numCols;
		this.player = getSinglePlayer();
		int gemCount = 0;
		for (int r = 0; r < numRows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < numCols; c++) {
				Cell cell = this.board[r][c];
				if (cell instanceof EntityCell ec && ec.getEntity() instanceof Gem) {
					gemCount++;
				}
			}
		}
		if (gemCount == 0) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("There must be at least one gem on the board");
		}
		if (!isAllGemsReachable()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Some gems are not reachable by the player");
		}
	}

	public Cell[] getRow(final int row) {
		if (row < 0 || row >= numRows) {
			throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException("Row index out of bounds: " + row);
		}
		return board[row].clone();
	}

	public Cell[] getCol(final int col) {
		if (col < 0 || col >= numCols) {
			throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException("Column index out of bounds: " + col);
		}
		Cell[] column = new Cell[numRows];
		for (int row = 0; row < numRows; row++) {
			column[row] = board[row][col];
		}
		return column;
	}

	public Cell getCell(final int row, final int col) {
		if (row < 0 || row >= numRows) {
			throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException("Row index out of bounds: " + row);
		}
		if (col < 0 || col >= numCols) {
			throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException("Column index out of bounds: " + col);
		}
		return board[row][col];
	}

	public Cell getCell(final Position position) {
		Objects.requireNonNull(position, "Position cannot be null");
		int row = position.row();
		int col = position.col();
		if (row < 0 || row >= numRows) {
			throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException("Row index out of bounds: " + row);
		}
		if (col < 0 || col >= numCols) {
			throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException("Column index out of bounds: " + col);
		}
		return board[row][col];
	}

	public EntityCell getEntityCell(final int row, final int col) {
		Cell cell = getCell(row, col);
		if (!(cell instanceof EntityCell entityCell)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cell at (" + row + ", " + col + ") is not an EntityCell.");
		}
		return entityCell;
	}
}
```

```java
			if (cells[r] == null || cells[r].length != numCols) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("All rows must have length equal to numCols");

			System.arraycopy(cells[r], 0, this.board[r], 0, numCols);

		this.numRows = numRows;
		this.numCols = numCols;
		this.player = getSinglePlayer();
		int gemCount = 0;
		for (int r = 0; r < numRows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < numCols; c++) {
				Cell cell = this.board[r][c];
				if (cell instanceof EntityCell ec && ec.getEntity() instanceof Gem) {
					gemCount++;
				}
			}
		}
		if (gemCount == 0) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("There must be at least one gem on the board");
		}
		if (!isAllGemsReachable()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Some gems are not reachable by the player");
		}
	}

	public Cell[] getRow(final int row) {

			throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException("Row index out of bounds: " + row);
```

```java
	 * Checks that a single player exists on the game board, and returns the instance of the player.
	 *
	 * @return The single instance of player on the game board.
	 * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the game board has zero, or more than one player entities.
	 */
	@NotNull
	private Player getSinglePlayer() {
		Player player = null;
		for (final var row : board) {
			for (final var cell : row) {
				if (cell instanceof EntityCell ec && ec.getEntity() instanceof Player p) {
					if (player != null) {
						throw new IllegalArgumentException();
					}

					player = p;
				}
			}
		}

		if (player == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException();
		}

		return player;
	}

	/**
	 * Retrieves the instance of {@link EntityCell} by a position with an offset.
	 *
	 * @param pos    Position.
	 * @param offset Positional offset to apply.
	 * @return An instance of {@link EntityCell}, or {@code null} if the resulting position does not contain an entity
	 * cell.
	 */
	@Nullable
	private Position getEntityCellByOffset(@NotNull final Position pos, @NotNull final PositionOffset offset) {
		final var newPos = pos.offsetByOrNull(offset, getNumRows(), getNumCols());
		if (newPos == null) {
			return null;
		}
		if (getCell(newPos) instanceof Wall) {
			return null;
		}

		return newPos;

	/**
	 * Gets all {@link Position} of cells which the player can stop on from the cell of the {@code initialPosition}.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * A cell is "stoppable" iff the player can stop on the cell with any combination of valid moves.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @param initialPosition The starting position to get all stoppable cells.
	 * @return {@link List} of all positions stoppable from {@code initialPosition}.
	 */
	@NotNull
	private List<Position> getAllStoppablePositions(@NotNull final Position initialPosition) {
		Objects.requireNonNull(initialPosition);

		final List<Position> allStoppablePos = new ArrayList<>();
		final List<Position> posToTraverse = new ArrayList<>();

		posToTraverse.add(initialPosition);

		while (!posToTraverse.isEmpty()) {
			final var nextPos = posToTraverse.remove(posToTraverse.size() - 1);

			if (!(getCell(nextPos) instanceof EntityCell)) {
				continue;
			}
			if (allStoppablePos.contains(nextPos)) {
				continue;
			}
			allStoppablePos.add(nextPos);

			for (@NotNull
			final var dir : Direction.values()) {
				for (int i = 0; i < Math.max(getNumRows(), getNumCols()); ++i) {
					final var posOffset = new PositionOffset(dir.getRowOffset() * i, dir.getColOffset() * i);
					final var posToAdd = getEntityCellByOffset(nextPos, posOffset);

					if (posToAdd == null) {
						final var maxDist = i - 1;
						if (maxDist > 0) {
							final var posOffsetBeforeThis = new PositionOffset(dir.getRowOffset() * maxDist,
									dir.getColOffset() * maxDist);
							final var posBeforeThis = getEntityCellByOffset(nextPos, posOffsetBeforeThis);

							if (posBeforeThis != null && !posToTraverse.contains(posBeforeThis)) {
								posToTraverse.add(posBeforeThis);
							}
						}

						break;
					}

					if (getCell(posToAdd) instanceof StopCell || isBorderCell(posToAdd, dir)) {
						posToTraverse.add(posToAdd);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		return Collections.unmodifiableList(allStoppablePos);

	 * before going out of bounds in the given direction.

	private boolean isBorderCell(@NotNull final Position cellPos, @NotNull final Direction dir) {
		return switch (dir) {

		case LEFT -> cellPos.col() == 0;
		case RIGHT -> cellPos.col() == getNumCols() - 1;

	private boolean isAllGemsReachable() {

		final var playerReachableCells = getAllReachablePositions(initialPosition);

			if (cell instanceof EntityCell ec && ec.getEntity() instanceof Gem) {
				++actualNumOfGems;
			}
		}

		return expectedNumOfGems == actualNumOfGems;
	}
```
